Migratsiya, malakali kadrlar oqimi, rivojlanayotgan mamlakatlar, turmush darajasi.
Mijoz kafeda buyurtma bergan, lekin boshqa narsa keltirishgan.
Mijozlarga rasmiy e’lon yozing (masalan, xizmat vaqtincha to‘xtashi haqida): Should …, Were … to … va Had … tuzilmalaridan kamida ikkitasini ishlating.
Mikrofondan ovoz kelmadi. Telefonni og‘izga yaqinroq tuting, mikrofon ruxsatini tekshiring va yana bosing.
Mikrofonga ruxsat berilmagan. Brauzer sozlamalarida ruxsat bering.
Minora endi poydevor qo‘ydi. Keyingi safar birinchi gapni oldindan o‘ylab qo‘ying va to‘xtamang!
Misol ishoralari: for instance, specifically, such as.
Misol: Social media causes depression. → Excessive use of social media may contribute to depression in some teenagers.
Misol: “Many people believe that technology makes us lonely.” → “It is widely believed that technology leads to isolation.” → “The belief that technology fosters loneliness is widespread.”

Misollar: “I play football on Saturdays.” “She goes swimming twice a week.” “He does yoga in the morning.” Eslab qoling: musiqa asbobi oldidan the qo‘yiladi — “play the guitar”, lekin o‘yin oldidan qo‘yilmaydi — “play football”.
Mock Arena: barcha Reading va Listening testlari — cheksiz
Mock natijasi uchun kamida 2 ta ko‘nikma kerak.
Mock testlar bepul. AI baho: haftasiga {0} ta Writing va {1} ta Speaking bepul.
Mock testlar bepul. Obuna — cheksiz darslar, AI baho va Sellzen.
Modal + be + V3: must be done, should be checked, can be used, will be sent. Qoidalar va rasmiy ko‘rsatmalarda juda ko‘p: “Mobile phones must be switched off.”
Modal fe’llar va infinitiv bilan majhul nisbatni (must be signed, wants to be told) qoidalar va talablarni yozishda ishlatasiz.
Modal perfect continuous (must have been -ing) va future perfect continuous (will have been -ing) bilan davomiylik va taxminni aniq ifodalaysiz.
Mozart hayot emas — tugagan davr: Past Simple.
Muallif ijtimoiy tarmoqlar yolg‘izlikni kuchaytiradi, deb ta’kidlaydi.
Muallif o‘z fikrini aytmagan → NOT GIVEN.
Muallif uy vazifasi qisqaroq bo‘lishi kerak deb hisoblaydi.
Mualliflar tanlanma kichik bo‘lganini ta’kidlab o‘tadi.
Muammo-yechim savolida asosiy e’tiborni g‘oyalarga qarating
Muammo-yechim savolida o‘z fikringizni yozib, yechimni unutish.
Muammodan xabarim bo‘lganida, yordam bergan bo‘lardim.

Muammolar va odatlar: “My battery is low.” “I charge my phone every night.” “I turn off my phone at night.” “The Wi-Fi is slow.” Savol: “What do you use your phone for?” — “I use it to listen to music.”

Muammolar: “The Wi-Fi doesn’t work.” “There is no hot water.” “Can I have another towel, please?” (another — yana bitta). “My room is too noisy.” (juda shovqinli). So‘rovlar Can I have…? bilan muloyim bo‘ladi.
Muddat qisqa — maqsad yoki sanani o‘zgartiring.

Muhim (essential) ma’lumot — olib tashlansa ma’no o‘zgaradi — vergulsiz yoziladi: “The student who won the prize is my cousin.” (qaysi talaba ekani shu qism bilan aniqlanadi). Ega va kesim orasiga, kesim va to‘ldiruvchi orasiga yolg‘iz vergul qo‘yilmaydi: “The results of the survey, were clear.” — xato.
Muhim bir kun yoki joyni tasvirlang: kamida bir marta joy + fe’l + ega (On the hill stood…) va So … was … that / Such was … that tuzilmasini ishlating.

Muhim farq: o‘zbek tilida “Menimcha, bu yaxshi emas” deymiz — inkor ikkinchi qismda turadi. Inglizchada esa odatda inkor think ga o‘tadi: I don’t think it’s a good idea. (“I think it isn’t a good idea” grammatik xato emas, lekin g‘ayritabiiy eshitiladi.) Fikr so‘rash: What do you think (of / about) …? How do you feel about …?
Muhim kunga (imtihon, intervyu) tayyorgarligingizni yozing: nimaga majbur bo‘ldingiz, nima shart emas edi, nimani behuda qildingiz.
Muhim qoida: does ishlatilganda asosiy fe’l -s olmaydi! “Does she works?” — xato, “Does she work?” — to‘g‘ri. -s allaqachon does da bor.
Muhim: ikkinchi qismda gap tartibi oddiy gapdagidek — ega + fe’l: where the station IS (where is the station emas). do / does / did yo‘qoladi: “Do you know where he lives?” (where does he live emas).

Mukofot faqat shartlarda ko‘rsatilgan hodisalar uchun hisoblanadi. Qaytarilgan to‘lovlar ayriladi; ro‘yxatdan o‘tganlik va tasdiqlanmagan ko‘rishlar uchun to‘lov yo‘q. Kutish davridagi summa taxminiy.
Mukofot shartlari va balansingiz pastdagi «Bonus / komissiya holati» bo‘limida.

Mukofot turi, summasi va shartlari to‘liq shu yerda sozlanadi — kod o‘zgarmaydi. Ro‘yxatdan o‘tganlik va tasdiqlanmagan ko‘rishlar uchun mukofot yo‘q. Qoida avval o‘chiq (qoralama) bo‘ladi; yoqish uchun summa/foiz, hamkor chegarasi va umumiy byudjet kerak. Summalar so‘mda kiritiladi.
Mukofotlar «Kutilmoqda» bo‘lib hisoblanadi (har 6 soatda yoki «Hozir hisoblash»); kutish muddatidan keyin «Tasdiqlash», tashqarida to‘lab «To‘langan deb belgilash» ni bosing.
Muloyim e’tiroz: I’m not sure about that.
Muloyim iltimos: Could you…? (Can you… ham to‘g‘ri).
Muloyim iltimos: Could you…? Could I…?
Muloyim rad etish: “I’m sorry, I can’t. I’m busy on Saturday.” “I’d love to, but I have to work.” Faqat “No” deyish qo‘pol eshitiladi.
Muloyim rad: I’m sorry, I can’t + sabab.
Muloyim savol: Could you tell me where…?
Muloyim savol: Will you be using the car tonight? (Rejangizni so‘rash, iltimos qilishdan oldin.)
Muloyim savol: Will you be using…?

Muloyim va aniq yozing: vaqt va joyni ayting — “Meet me at the station at 5.” Savolga kerakli javob bering. “Can you…?” — “Sure!” yoki “Sorry, I can’t. I’m busy.” Emoji tilingizni to‘ldiradi, lekin so‘zlar o‘rnini bosmaydi.

Muloyim yozish: “Hello, I want to order two books. Do you have free delivery?” Muammo: “My order doesn’t arrive.” — “It doesn’t arrive” hozirgi zamon; mahsulot noto‘g‘ri bo‘lsa: “It is the wrong size.” (noto‘g‘ri o‘lcham).
Muloyimlik uchun o‘tgan zamon: I was wondering if…

Munosabat fe’llari: supports (qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi), challenges / refutes (rad etadi), qualifies (cheklaydi), extends (davom ettiradi), complements (to‘ldiradi), offers an alternative (muqobil beradi). Ko‘pincha ikki muallif bir mavzuda yozadi, lekin aniq bir da’voga turlicha qaraydi — javob aynan SHU da’voga bog‘liq bo‘lishi kerak.
Munozara va esse: tinglovchini ishontirish, jonli og‘zaki nutq va mantiqiy aniq yozma bog‘lanish.
Munozara: sun’iy intellekt va ish o‘rinlari
Munozarada fikr bildirish: kuchli sifatlar, umumlashtirish va fikrni muvozanatli tuzish.
Munozarali mavzuda ehtiyotkor, mantiqiy va boy tilda fikr bildirish — IELTS Writing Task 2 va Speaking Part 3 uchun asosiy ko‘nikma.
Muntazam sport bilan shug‘ullanadigan odamlar yaxshiroq uxlaydi.
Murakkab esse va nutqda fikrlarni nozik bog‘lash: yon berish, fikrni ot sifatida qurish, matn bog‘liqligi.

Murakkab foiz: A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt). Yiliga bir marta bo‘lsa: A = P(1 + r)^t. Masalan, 1000 dollar, 4% yillik: A = 1000(1,04)^t. “Har 3 yilda ikki baravar” → y = a · 2^(t/3). Jadvalda qiymatlar bir xil marta ko‘paysa — ko‘rsatkichli; bir xil miqdorga ortsa — chiziqli.
Murakkab matnlarni tushunasiz. Maqsad: ball va aniqlik.
Murakkab old va orqa qo‘shimchalar (counter-, mis-, over-, under-, -ise, -ity, -wise) bilan yangi so‘zlarni yasaysiz va tushunasiz.
Musbat summa — bonus, manfiy — tuzatish. Sabab majburiy; yozuv «kutilmoqda» bo‘ladi va umumiy tasdiqlash oqimidan o‘tadi.
Musiqa asbobi oldidan the: play the guitar.
Musiqa asboblari bilan 'play the ...' qolipi ishlatiladi.
Mustahkam minora! Endi oltin g‘ishtlarni — because, however, for example — ko‘proq ishlating.
Mustaqil gapni boshqasi bilan to‘g‘ri ulaysiz (nuqta, nuqta-vergul, vergul + bog‘lovchi) va fragment, run-on, comma splice xatolarini topasiz.
Mutaxassisimiz rejangizni tushuntirib beradi va savollaringizga javob beradi.
Muvaffaqiyatsiz loyiha haqida tahliliy paragraf yozing: kamida 4 ta yasama so‘z (underestimate, counterproductive, prioritise, -wise…).
Muvaffaqiyatsiz yakunlangan voqea (ish, sayohat) haqida xushmuomala e’lon yoki xat yozing: evfemizm va understatement bilan.
Muvozanatli fikr: on the other hand, having said that
Muzey bo‘ylab ekskursiya oldidan ma’lumot (B1 daraja, IELTS Part 2 uslubida).
Muzeydan o‘g‘irlangan rasm haqida yangilik yozing: seem / be believed to have…, having + V3 va majhul shakllar bilan.
My favourite film is + a + janr.
My favourite room is + the + xona.
My friends and I = we → oddiy shakl: play.
My grandfather has got a white ___. (soqol)
My name — bitta narsa (ism), shuning uchun is.
NIMA?! “{wrong}”?! Ahmoq, miyang bormi o‘zi?! To‘g‘risi “{right}”, yodla!
NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS kabi ko‘rsatmalarga amal qilib, matndagi so‘zni grammatik to‘g‘ri va xatosiz yozasiz.
NOT GIVEN — matnda bu haqida ma’lumot YO‘Q: na tasdiqlanadi, na rad etiladi. Eng ko‘p xato: o‘zingiz bilgan yoki mantiqiy tuyulgan narsani TRUE deb belgilash. Faqat matnga ishoning!
Nafis yon berish: much as, hard as it is
Namuna barcha sinovlardan o‘tolmadi, shuning uchun hammasini boshidan boshlashga to‘g‘ri keldi.
Namuna bilan solishtiring: «{0}». Boshqa to‘g‘ri variant ham bo‘lishi mumkin.
Naqdmi yoki kartami? — Karta bilan, iltimos.
Narsa bilan -ing kerak emas: I love ice cream.
Narsa haqida -ing kerak emas: I like pizza. I love my city. Inkor: I don’t like getting up early. She doesn’t like cooking.
Narsa qayerda turganini in, on, under, next to, behind, in front of, between bilan aytasiz va Where is…? deb so‘raysiz.

Narsa qayerdaligini aytish uchun joy predloglari ishlatiladi: in (ichida), on (ustida, sirtida), under (ostida), next to (yonida), behind (orqasida), in front of (oldida), between (orasida). Savol: “Where is my phone?” — “It’s on the table.”
Narsa: that / which (bu yerda tushirib qoldirish ham mumkin).
Narsani ko‘rsatib: “This is a pen.” (Bu — ruchka.) O‘zbek tilida “bir” so‘zi shart emas, ingliz tilida esa bitta narsadan oldin a yoki an kerak. “This is pen” — xato.
Narx haqida fikr yo‘q → NOT GIVEN.
Narx savoli: How much is + narsa?
Narx so‘rash: How much is + narsa.
Narx so‘rash: How much is this? / How much are these shoes? Sanalmaydigan narsani sanash uchun idish yoki birlik ishlatiladi: a bottle of water, a kilo of rice, a loaf of bread.
Narx so‘rash: bitta narsa — How much is this T-shirt? Ko‘p yoki juft narsa — How much are these shoes? Javob: It’s fifteen pounds. / They’re forty dollars.
Natija (yangi gap yoki nuqtali vergul bilan): therefore, consequently, as a result, thus: The price rose. Consequently, demand fell.
Natija + ot: lead to, result in, cause: Pollution can lead to health problems. Xato: “result to”, “lead in”.
Natija va soni uchun present perfect simple, jarayon va davomiylik uchun present perfect continuous’ni tanlaysiz.
Natija yoki jarayon? (present perfect vs continuous)
Natija — yangi gap boshida, vergul bilan.
Natijada ularda ish uchun ko‘proq kuch qoladi.
Natijalar aniq xulosa bermadi, shuning uchun qo‘shimcha tadqiqot zarur.
Natijani kafolatlamang: «band beramiz», «albatta o‘tasiz» kabi da’volar mumkin emas.
Natijani ko‘rish va saqlash uchun bepul ro‘yxatdan o‘ting
Navbat sizda — endi siz harakat qilasiz.
Navoiyni o‘zbek adabiyotidagi eng buyuk shoir desa bo‘ladi.
Nazariya qabul qilingan — demak keyingi tadqiqotlar uni tasdiqlagan: corroborated.
Nechta talaba topshirgani aytilmagan — qolganlar haqida bilmaymiz → NOT GIVEN.
Nega ba’zi odamlar ovqat pishirishni yaxshi ko‘radi?
Never / Rarely / Seldom + aux + ega + fe’l
Never, Rarely, Seldom, Not only, Hardly … when, No sooner … than, Under no circumstances, Only then kabi so‘zlar gap boshiga chiqsa, savoldagi kabi tartib bo‘ladi: yordamchi fe’l + ega + asosiy fe’l.
New schools are needed to ___ the growing demand for places. (qondirmoq)
Nihoyat, yarim tunda Buxoroga yetib keldik.
Nima ish qilasiz? — Men talabaman. Siz-chi?
Nima og‘riyotganini aytasiz (I have a headache, My back hurts), Nima bo‘ldi? deb so‘raysiz va oddiy maslahatni tushunasiz.
Nima uchun ingliz tilini o‘rganasiz? Chunki sayohat qilmoqchiman.
Nima uchun ingliz tilini o‘rganayotganingizni yoki sevimli faslingizni sabab bilan yozing (because va so ni ishlating).

Nima uchun ishlatishni aytish: use + narsa + to + fe’l — “I use my phone to call my family.” “She uses the internet to learn English.” “We use apps to order food.” Fe’l oldidan to qo‘yiladi, fe’l o‘zgarmaydi; he / she / it bilan faqat use → uses.
Nima, kim pishiradi, qachon yeysiz, nega yoqadi.
Nimalarni qila olishingiz va qila olmasligingiz haqida 3 ta gap yozing (can / can’t).
Nimalarni yaxshi ko‘rasiz va nimalarni yoqtirmaysiz? 3–4 gap yozing (love / like / hate + -ing).
Nimani xohlashingiz va nima qilishingiz kerakligini want to, need to, like to + fe’l bilan aytasiz.

Nimani xohlashingizni aytish: want to + fe’l (xohlamoq), kerakligini aytish: need to + fe’l (kerak), yoqtirishni: like to + fe’l. Fe’l oldidan TO qo‘yiladi, fe’lning o‘zi o‘zgarmaydi: “I want to learn English.” “We need to study.”

Nisbat a : b — bo‘laklar. Butun = a + b bo‘lak; qismi = a / (a + b). Misol: o‘g‘il : qiz = 3 : 5, jami 40 o‘quvchi → bir bo‘lak = 40 / 8 = 5; qizlar = 5 · 5 = 25. Proporsiya a / b = c / d → ad = bc (kesishtirib ko‘paytirish). Tenglamani tuzishda BIR XIL birlikni suratga va maxrajga qo‘ying.
Nisbat va tezlik, foiz, o‘rtacha va tarqoqlik, nuqtali grafiklar, ehtimollik va tanlanma tadqiqotlari.
Nisbat, tezlik, proporsiya va o‘lchov birliklarini almashtirish
Nisbatni butun bilan bog‘laysiz, proporsiya tuzasiz, tezlik va narx masalalarini yechasiz va o‘lchov birliklarini to‘g‘ri almashtirasiz.
Nisbiy gap: the film + that + we watched ... + was ...
Nisbiy gaplar: who, which, that, where, whose
Nisbiy olmosh ega bo‘lmasa (to‘ldiruvchi bo‘lsa), aniqlovchi gapda uni tushirib qoldirish mumkin: The book (that) I bought is great. Xato: “The book that I bought it” — ortiqcha it.
No sooner + had + ega + V3 … than.
Noaniq so'zlarni ('good', 'a lot') aniq so'zlar bilan almashtiring.
Noaniq til: sort of, or so, -ish, and whatnot
Noldan A1 dan C2 gacha, bo‘lim-bo‘lim

Nominal gap — butun gap ot o‘rnida turadi. what-gap to‘ldiruvchi yoki ega bo‘ladi: “I can’t believe what he said.” “What she suggested made sense.” (C1 dagi “What I need is…” — cleft, urg‘u uchun; bu yerda esa what-gap oddiy ot vazifasida.)
Nomzod marketing menejeri lavozimi uchun suhbatda.
Non, pishloq, meva va shunga o‘xshash narsalar oldik.
Noqulay mavzularni evfemizmlar bilan muloyim aytasiz va understatement (not exactly, a bit of) orqali nozik tanqid qilasiz.
Nor dan keyin yaqin ega — employees (ko‘plik): were.
Nor dan keyin yaqin ega — engineers: were.
Nor dan keyingi ega (employees) ko‘plik — were.

Norasmiy e-mail (do‘st, qarindoshga) tuzilishi: 1) salomlashish — Hi Sarah, / Dear Sarah,; 2) kirish — Thanks for your email. It was great to hear from you.; 3) asosiy qism — yangiliklar va savollarga javob; 4) yakun — I can’t wait to see you. Write back soon!; 5) xayrlashuv — Best wishes, / Love, / See you soon, + ismingiz.
Norasmiy e-mail: Thanks for your email…
Norasmiy matnni akademik uslubda qayta yozing: “Lots of kids don’t do enough sport, and that’s a big thing. They get fat and it’s bad for their health. Schools can’t do much.”
Norasmiy so‘zlar (nice, kids, a lot of, stuff)
Norasmiy so‘zlarni (a lot of, get, kids, thing) akademik muqobillar bilan almashtirasiz va so‘z takrorini kamaytirasiz.
Norasmiy uslub: phrasal verb, qisqartma (it’s, don’t), shaxsiy olmosh, oddiy so‘zlar: “We need to find out why sales went down.”

Norasmiy uslubda qisqartmalar (I’m, can’t), oddiy so‘zlar va so‘zlashuv bog‘lovchilari ishlatiladi: Anyway, … (mavzuni o‘zgartirish), By the way, … (aytgancha), Guess what? (bilasanmi nima bo‘ldi?). Rasmiy iboralar (I am writing to inform you…, Yours faithfully) do‘stga g‘alati eshitiladi.
Norasmiy: Do‘kon qachon ochilishini bilib bera olasanmi?
Noreal holatlarni it’s (high) time, as if / as though va suppose / supposing bilan ifodalaysiz.
Not Given — matnda aytilmagan degani. Jim matn "True" degani emas.
Not only + aux + ega …, but … also
Notanish odamdan muloyim so‘rash, suhbatni davom ettirish va fikrga qo‘shilish.
Noto‘g‘ri shakllar: good → better → the best; bad → worse → the worst; far → further → the furthest.

Nuqta-vergul (;) faqat ikki MUSTAQIL gap orasida turadi: ikkala tomon ham alohida gap bo‘la olishi kerak. Ikki nuqta (:) dan OLDIN to‘liq gap bo‘lishi shart, keyin ro‘yxat, izoh yoki misol keladi: “She packed three things: a map, a compass and water.” Ikki nuqtadan oldin “She packed:” kabi to‘liq bo‘lmagan qism qo‘yilsa — xato.

Nuqtali grafik (scatterplot) va eng yaxshi mos chiziq y = mx + b: m — x bir birlik oshganda y ning TAXMINIY o‘zgarishi; b — x = 0 dagi taxminiy y. Bog‘liqlik musbat (yuqoriga), manfiy (pastga) yoki yo‘q. Qoldiq (residual) = haqiqiy − bashorat qilingan. Ma’lumotlar oralig‘idan tashqarida bashorat (extrapolation) ishonchsiz. Bog‘liqlik sababni isbotlamaydi.

Nusxalang va Telegram, Instagram yoki TikTok’da ulashing — havolangiz matn ichida. Eng yaxshi natija: o‘z daraja testi natijangizni yoki mock balingizni ko‘rsatib, obunachilarni bellashuvga chaqirish.
Nusxalar server diski ichida: disk yo‘qolsa, ular ham yo‘qoladi. BACKUP_S3_* sozlang.

Nutq tartibi: kirish gap (“I’d like to talk about…”), har nuqta navbat bilan, bog‘lovchilar (First of all, After that, What I liked most was…). Ko‘pincha o‘tgan zamon kerak bo‘ladi. Imtihonchi to‘xtatguncha gapirishda davom eting.
Nutq tezligi past. Fikrni to‘xtamasdan davom ettirishga harakat qiling.
Nutqni tanib bo‘lmadi, qayta urinib ko‘ring.
Nutqni tanish internet talab qiladi, aloqa yo‘q
Nutqni tanish to‘xtab qoldi. Qayta urinib ko‘ring.
Nutqni tanish xizmati bilan aloqa yo‘q.
O'tgan zamon aniq vaqt (yesterday), majhul nisbat: was + V3.
O'tgan zamon belgisi (yesterday) bilan fe'l ham o'tgan zamonda bo'lishi kerak.
O'tgan zamon fe'li topilmadi (went, watched, was ...).
O'tgan zamon inkori: did not (didn't) + fe'l asl shaklda.
O'tgan zamon savoli: Did + ega + fe'l asl shaklda.
O'tgan zamon savoli: did + ega + fe'l (buy, bought emas).
O'tgan zamon: go → went. 'to the cinema' (artikl 'the' bilan).
O'tgan zamon: oddiy fe'llarga -ed qo'shiladi: watched.
O'tmishdagi ikki voqeadan oldin sodir bo'lgani uchun Past Perfect (had + V3).
O'tmishdagi xayoliy holat (Third Conditional): If + had + V3, would have + V3.
O'zgarishni aytganda Present Perfect (has changed, has been built) ishlating.
O'zingiz haqingizda 'in my opinion' / 'I think' deyiladi. 'According to' boshqa manba uchun.
Ob-havoni It’s cold / It’s sunny bilan aytasiz va fasllar haqida In winter it snows kabi gap tuzasiz.
Obuna avtomatik yangilanmaydi — muddat tugagach, xohlasangiz qayta to‘laysiz.
Obuna hisobingizga bog‘lanadi. Avval hisobingizga kiring.
Obuna hisobingizga yoziladi: boshqa qurilmada ham shu hisob bilan kirasiz.
Obunasiz o‘quvchilar uchun kunlik va haftalik chegaralar.
Ochiq to‘lovlaringiz ko‘p. Avval bittasini yakunlang yoki bekor qiling.
Odam bitta bo‘lsa — is (he’s, she’s), bir nechta bo‘lsa — are (they’re). “They is” deyilmaydi: They are teachers.
Odam yoki narsani ko‘rsatib, to‘g‘ri olmoshni (he, she, it, they) tanlaysiz: He is a boy. It is a book.

Odam yo‘q bo‘lsa: I’m sorry, she’s not here at the moment. Can I take a message? Qo‘ng‘iroq qilgan odam: Could you ask her to call me back? Farqiga e’tibor bering: xabarni qabul qilgan odam take a message, qoldirgan odam esa leave a message deydi.
Odam, narsa, joyni aniqlash uchun who / which / that / where / whose bilan ergash gap tuzasiz; aniqlovchi va qo‘shimcha ma’lumot beruvchi turlarini ajratasiz.
Odamlar haqida umumiy gapiring: “people”, “young people”, “in many countries”. Faqat “I” dan foydalanmang — 3-qism jamiyat haqida.
Odamlar ilgari xat yozishardi, hozir esa xabar yuborishadi.
Odamlar oziq-ovqat, turizm va to‘lqindan himoya uchun bog‘liq
Odamlarni baxtli qiladigan narsa pul emas.
Odamlarni va his-tuyg‘ularni tasvirlash: kim qanday ishlaydi, nima zeriktiradi, bu kimniki.
Odamlarning mutlaq ko‘pchiligi yangi qonunni qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi.
Odamni so‘rash: Can I speak to …?
Odamning tashqi ko‘rinishini be (He is tall) va have got (She has got blue eyes) bilan tasvirlaysiz.
Odat uchun 'am' kerak emas. O'zbekcha 'men o'qiyapman' deb o'ylab, 'am study' deb xato qilinadi.
Odat uchun present simple, hozirgi harakat uchun present continuous’ni tanlaysiz; know, like, want kabi fe’llarni -ing siz ishlatasiz.
Odatda avtobusda yuraman, lekin bugun piyoda ketyapman.
Odatiy harakat: Present Simple. 'She' bilan fe'lga -s/-es qo'shiladi.
Odatiy kuningiz va hozir (bugun) qilayotgan ishlaringizni taqqoslang: 2 ta present simple, 2 ta present continuous.
Odatiy suhbat: avval Present Perfect bilan umumiy savol, keyin tafsilot Past Simple’da: “Have you ever been to Bukhara?” — “Yes, I went there last spring.”

Odatiy xatolar: “The study has a lot of mistakes” (mistakes o‘rniga flaws / limitations), “based from” (to‘g‘risi based on), “fail to taking” (fail to + fe’lning asl shakli), “anecdotic” (to‘g‘risi anecdotal evidence — tasodifiy shaxsiy misollar). Inkorni faqat “not reliable” bilan cheklamang: of questionable reliability, open to question kabi ehtiyotkor iboralar akademik uslubga ko‘proq mos keladi.

Odatiy xatolar: “consistent to” (to‘g‘risi — consistent with), “concur to Lee” (to‘g‘risi — concur with Lee), “those of” ni tushirib qoldirish: “Ito’s results echo those of Hall” (Hall’ning natijalarini). Har manba uchun “says” ishlatmang — contend, maintain, demonstrate kabi aniq fe’llarni qo‘llang.

Odatlar: “I order food in an app.” “I add things to my basket and pay by card.” “The delivery takes two days.” “It arrives on Friday.” He / she / it bilan -s: orders, pays, arrives. Savol: “How long does delivery take?” “Can I return it?”
Odatlaringiz haqida 4 ta gap yozing: always, usually, sometimes, never dan foydalaning.
Oddiy (gradable) sifatlar darajaga ega: cold, tired, big, good. Ular very, extremely, a bit bilan keladi: very cold.
Oddiy ma’no: It’s time + to + fe’l.
Oddiy odat/holat uchun 'am' kerak emas: I study, I work, I live.
Oddiy sifatlarni very bilan, kuchli (extreme) sifatlarni absolutely / really bilan kuchaytirasiz.
Oddiy so‘z va iboralarni tushunasiz. Asosiy gaplarni tuzishni o‘rganasiz.
Oddiy so‘zlarni (good, bad, like) aniqroq so‘z va collocationlar bilan almashtirasiz, idiomalarni faqat mos joyda ishlatasiz.
Oddiy: I have never seen such a view. → Inversiya: Never have I seen such a view.
Og‘zaki hikoya va latifalarda o‘tgan voqea ko‘pincha hozirgi zamonda aytiladi — tinglovchi voqea ichida turgandek his qiladi: “So I’m walking down the street, and this man comes up to me and says…”
Og‘zaki nutq belgilari: mind you, anyway, as I was saying
Og‘zaki nutq bog‘lovchilari (actually, to be honest, mind you, what I mean is) bilan fikrlarni silliq ulaysiz va yozma uslubdan qochasiz.

Og‘zaki nutq yozma inshodan farq qiladi. Speaking’da “Furthermore, moreover, in conclusion” g‘alati eshitiladi. Tabiiy bog‘lovchilar: actually, to be honest, I mean, mind you, the thing is, as far as I know, on top of that.
Og‘zaki nutqda qisqa shakllar ko‘p ishlatiladi: I’m, you’re, he’s, she’s, it’s, we’re, they’re.
Og‘zaki nutqda tabiiy noaniqlik iboralari (sort of, or so, -ish, and stuff like that, roughly) bilan yumshoq va tabiiy gapirasiz.
Ohangidan uning norozi ekanini xulosa qildim.

Oila a’zolari: mother (ona), father (ota), brother (aka yoki uka), sister (opa yoki singil), grandmother (buvi), grandfather (bobo), uncle (amaki yoki tog‘a), aunt (xola yoki amma). Ingliz tilida aka bilan ukani alohida aytmaydilar — ikkalasi ham brother.
Oila a’zolari: my, your, his, her, our, their
Oila a’zolaringizdan biri haqida 5 gap yozing: u nima qiladi (he / she bilan fe’lga -s qo‘shing).
Oila a’zolaringizdan birining kuni haqida 3 ta gap yozing (he yoki she bilan).
Oila a’zolarini ingliz tilida ataysiz va my, your, his, her, our, their bilan kimniki ekanini bildirasiz.
Oila a’zongiz yoki do‘stingizga qanday sovg‘a berishingizni yozing va minnatdorchilikni ham ko‘rsating (give, Thank you).
Oilam uchun ovqat pishirishni yaxshi ko‘raman.
Oilangiz haqida 3 ta gap yozing: nechta aka-uka, opa-singil, bola bor (ko‘plik shakllari bilan).
Oilangiz haqida 4–5 gap yozing: kim bilan yashaysiz, ota-onangiz kim bo‘lib ishlaydi, qayerda yashaysiz.
Oilangiz haqida 4–5 gapdan iborat qisqa hikoyani aytasiz va yozasiz: kim, necha yoshda, kasbi va qayerda yashashi.
Oilangiz va do‘stlaringiz haqida gapirish: nechta aka-uka, kim kimni yaxshi ko‘radi, savol berib tanishish.
Oilangiz va do‘stlaringizni tanishtirish: kim kimning nimasi, ismi, yoshi, kasbi va qayerda yashashi.
Oilangiz yoki o‘zingiz haqingizda 4 gap yozing: and, but, or ni kamida ikkitasini ishlating.
Oilangizdagi 2 kishi haqida yozing: siz ular bilan nima qilasiz? (him, her, them, me, us dan kamida ikkitasi)
Oilangizdagi 3 kishini tasvirlang: ular nimani qanday qiladi? (-ly ravishlar va well)
Oilangizdagi 3 kishining kasbini yozing (a / an va my / his / her bilan).
Oilangizdagi ikki kishi haqida yozing: ular kim va ismi nima? (my va his yoki her dan foydalaning)
Oilangizdagi yoki do‘stlaringizdan biri qanaqa ko‘rinishda? Bo‘yi, sochi va ko‘zlarini tasvirlang.
Oilaviy rasmni tasavvur qiling: 2 ta odam va 1 ta narsa yoki hayvonni ko‘rsatib yozing (This is… He / She / It is…).
Old qo‘shimchalar: unfair, illegal, misunderstand, overestimate
Old unli bilan boshlanadi — an old house.
Oldindan o‘ylab qo‘yilgan reja yoki niyat: am / is / are + going to + fe’l. “I’m going to learn to drive this summer.”
Oldindan qilingan reja (chipta olingan): are going to.
Oldindan qilingan reja uchun going to, shu zahoti qabul qilingan qaror, va’da va fikrga asoslangan bashorat uchun will ni tanlaysiz.

Oldingi butun fikrni “this + ot” bilan umumlashtirish: “Prices have doubled. This increase has hit poor families hardest.” Umumlashtiruvchi otlar: this issue / trend / problem / approach / development / decision.
Oldingi harakat — Having + V3: Having finished the report, she went home. (= After she had finished…)
Oldingi pog‘onani bajardingiz — yangi pog‘ona ochildi!
Olib chiqdim, behuda — needn’t have taken.
Oliy ta’lim hamma uchun bepul bo‘lishi kerakmi?

Olmosh (pronoun) o‘zi ishora qilgan otga (antecedent) son va shaxs bo‘yicha moslashadi: “The committee made its decision.” (committee — birlik, shuning uchun its, their emas.) Noaniq olmosh xatosi: “When Aziz met Karim, he was late.” — he kim? SAT bunday gapda aniq otni qo‘yishni talab qiladi.
Olmosh va u ishora qilgan otni moslaysiz, boshlovchi aniqlovchi (modifier) ni to‘g‘ri otga bog‘laysiz va parallel tuzilmani saqlaysiz.
Olmosh, aniqlovchi, parallellik va ko‘plik shakli
Ona tilida so‘zlashuvchi kabi jonli gapirish: idiomalar, juft iboralar va muloyim yumshatish.
Ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar hamma narsani aniq aytmaydi — bu nutqni tabiiy va do‘stona qiladi. Taxminiy son: about, roughly, or so, -ish: “twenty or so people”, “at sevenish”, “around 50%”.
Ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar kabi ixcham gapirish: keraksiz takrorlarsiz, tabiiy qisqartmalar bilan.

Ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar maqolni ko‘pincha qisqartirib aytadi, chunki davomini hamma biladi: “Well, every cloud…” (= every cloud has a silver lining — har yomonlikning bir yaxshi tomoni bor), “When in Rome…” (= do as the Romans do — qayerda bo‘lsang, o‘sha yerning odatiga amal qil). Maqoldan ibora ham yasaladi: a silver lining (yaxshi tomon).
Ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar suhbatni kichik iboralar bilan boshqaradi. Mavzuni o‘zgartirish: by the way (aytgancha), anyway (xullas, nima bo‘lsa ham — asosiy mavzuga qaytish).
Ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar takrorlamaydi. Yordamchi fe’lda to‘xtashadi: “Have you finished?” — “Yes, I have.” (finished takrorlanmaydi) “She can’t swim, but her brother can.”
Onam past bo‘yli, sochlari uzun va qora.
Once + Present Perfect majhul: has been shaped.
Onlayn bank xizmatlari naqd pulsiz iqtisodiyotga yo‘l ochdi.
Onlayn bankingning joriy etilishi odamlarning odatlarini o‘zgartirdi.
Onlayn darslar xususiy darslarchalik qimmat emas.
Onlayn do‘konga 4 gaplik xabar yozing: nimani buyurtma qilmoqchisiz, bepul yetkazish bormi va qancha vaqt ketadi.
Onlayn kurslar shahar va qishloq ta’limi o‘rtasidagi tafovutni qisqartirishga yordam berishi mumkin.
Onlayn kurslar sinfdagi darsdek samarali bo‘lishi mumkin.
Onlayn o‘qiganlar sinfda o‘qiganlardan ikki baravar ko‘p edi.
Onlayn ta’lim moslashuvchan. Biroq u intizom talab qiladi.

Onlayn xarid so‘zlari: order (buyurtma bermoq), basket (savat), delivery (yetkazib berish), pay by card (karta bilan to‘lamoq), pay cash (naqd to‘lamoq), return (qaytarmoq), review (sharh), free delivery (bepul yetkazish), app (ilova).
Onlayn xarid so‘zlarini bilasiz (order, delivery, pay by card) va buyurtmangiz haqida present simple bilan gapirasiz.
Opam aeroport yaqinida yashaydi. Shuning uchun doim unikida qolaman.
Or dan keyin yaqin ega — players (ko‘plik): are.

Orqasidan: predlogli birikma (the increase in prices), qisqargan nisbiy gap — participle (the people living in rural areas, the report published last week), to-infinitive (the decision to close the factory).
Ortiqcha ma’lumotni (nonessential) vergul yoki tire bilan ajratasiz, vergulni noto‘g‘ri joyga qo‘ymaysiz va apostrofni (egalik, qisqartma) to‘g‘ri ishlatasiz.
Ortiqcha qism (a skilled pilot) ikki tomondan vergul bilan ajratiladi.
Ortiqcha qism (which opened in 1920) ikki tomondan bir xil — ikkita vergul bilan ajratiladi.
Ortiqcha qism ikki tomondan vergul bilan ajratiladi.
Ortiqcha qism ikki vergul bilan ajratilgan.
Ortiqcha so‘z va takrorni (redundancy) topasiz, ma’noni saqlagan holda eng qisqa grammatik to‘g‘ri variantni tanlaysiz.
Ortiqcha “it” qo‘yilmaydi; what nisbiy olmosh emas.
Orzuingizdagi ish va hamkasblarni tasvirlang: kamida 4 ta qo‘shma sifat (well-paid, open-minded, time-consuming…).
Ot (decline) oldida sifat: a gradual decline.
Ot (increase) oldida sifat keladi: a sharp increase.
Ot + who + fe’l + asosiy gap davomi.
Ot bilan to kerak emas: “I want a coffee.” Fe’l bilan to kerak: “I want to drink coffee.” Maqsadni aytishga yaroqli ibora: “I want to speak English well.” “I need to practise every day.”
Ot bilan: “The more money he earns, the more he spends.” Sifat bilan: “The older I get, the wiser I feel.” Qisqa shakl: “The sooner, the better.” “The bigger, the better.”
Ota-onam avlodiga qaraganda biz ancha ko‘p sayohat qilamiz.
Otam hech qachon mashinasini haydashga ruxsat bermagan.
Otam qirq besh yoshda. U haydovchi.
Otdan oldin defis qo‘yiladi: a well-known writer. to be dan keyin ko‘pincha defissiz ham yoziladi: The writer is well known. Son + ot birlikda: a two-hour meeting (two-hours emas).
Otlarning ko‘plik shaklini (-s, -es, -ies va children, people kabi istisnolar) to‘g‘ri yozasiz.
Otlashtirish + rasmiy sifat: a considerable increase.
Otni oldidan (sifat, ot) va orqasidan (predlogli birikma, participle) kengaytirib, ma’lumotni bitta zich birikmaga joylaysiz.
Our team ___ (perform) all the others. (o‘zib ketdi)
Overview: necha bosqich, qayerdan boshlanib qayerda tugaydi: “Overall, there are six stages, beginning with … and ending with …”. Tabiiy jarayon (suv aylanishi) bo‘lsa — faol nisbat ham to‘g‘ri.
Overview’siz Task 1 odatda Task Achievement bo‘yicha 5 dan yuqori olmaydi. Overview — eng katta/kichik, umumiy trend (o‘sdimi, kamaydimi), eng katta farq. Unda SONLAR yozilmaydi.
Ovoz eshitildimi? Eshitilmasa, naushnik yoki ovoz balandligini tekshiring.
Ovoz eshitilmadi — mikrofonga yaqinroq gapirib ko‘ring.
Ovoz kelmayapti. Telefonni og‘izga yaqinroq tuting yoki mikrofon ruxsatini tekshiring.
Ovoz xizmati sozlanmagan: umumiy kunlik chegara belgilanmagan.
Ovozli rejim uchun Chrome yoki Safari kerak — hozircha yozib javob bering.
Ovozli tanish bugun vaqtincha band. Yozib yuboring.
Ovqat juda yaxshi edi, lekin xizmat dahshatli edi.
Ovqat nomlari (breakfast, lunch, dinner) odatda artiklsiz ishlatiladi.
Ovqat pishirishni sinov va xatolar orqali o‘rgandim.
Oxirgi 3 daqiqa: barcha savollarga javob borligini tekshiring (bo‘sh joy = 0 ball), so‘z chegarasi va imloni ko‘rib chiqing. Hech qachon oxirgi matnni boshlamay qoldirmang — oson savollar ham bor.
Oxirgi 30 kunda «{0}» bo‘yicha {1} marta xato qildingiz. «{2}» darsi aynan shu xatoni nishonga oladi.
Oxirgi qadam: telefon raqamingizni ulashing. Hisobingizni himoyalash va kerak bo‘lsa mutaxassisimiz bog‘lanishi uchun.
Oxiri kursni tugatding — kech bo‘lsa ham, hech bo‘lmagandan yaxshi!
Oy nomi katta harf bilan: May.
Oy, kun va soat bilan in / on / at ni adashtirmay ishlatasiz.
Oylik narx; 3 oylik (−10%) va 12 oylik (10 oy narxi) shundan hisoblanadi. Yangi to‘lovlarga qo‘llanadi.
O‘chiq bo‘lsa, /start bosilganda darhol xush kelibsiz xabari keladi (reklama tarmoqlari talabi uchun).
O‘g‘il bolalar matematikada kuchliroq degan fikr shunchaki noto‘g‘ri.
O‘lcham: small, medium, large (S, M, L). Have you got this in a large? — Yes, here you are. Kiyib ko‘rish: Can I try it on? (it — so‘z o‘rtasida: try it on). can bilan iltimos — A1 da o‘rgangansiz.

O‘lchov birliklari: metre (metr), kilometre (kilometr), centimetre (santimetr), kilo / kilogram (kilogramm), litre (litr), degree (daraja), percent (foiz). Sondan keyin birlik ko‘plik oladi: “two metres”, “five kilos”, “three litres”, “twenty-five degrees”. Bitta bo‘lsa birlik: “one metre”, “one litre”.
O‘n daqiqadan keyin sizga qayta qo‘ng‘iroq qilsam maylimi?
O‘n ikki soat ishladingiz. Juda charchagan bo‘lsangiz kerak.

O‘qish odatlari present simple bilan aytiladi: “I practise English every day.” “I listen to podcasts on the bus.” “I write new words in my notebook.” Foydali fe’llar: study, practise, read, listen to, write, repeat, remember (eslab qolmoq).
O‘qituvchi bilan qisqa suhbat yozing: salomlashing, iltimos bilan bir narsa so‘rang, rahmat ayting va xayrlashing.
O‘qituvchi kichikroq tanlanma olishni taklif qildi.
O‘qituvchiga 3 ta savol yozing: How do you say…? What does … mean? Can you repeat…?
O‘qituvchilik juda qoniqarli kasb bo‘lishi mumkin.
O‘quv loyihasi haqida talaba va o‘qituvchi — 3-qism.
O‘quvchilar: Profil → «Guruhga qo‘shilish» bo‘limiga shu kodni yozadi.
O‘quvchilarni haddan tashqari qattiq jazolash teskari natija berishi mumkin.
O‘rniga so‘z: I think so, I hope not, the red one
O‘rta uzunlikdagi matnlar, barcha savol turlari
O‘rtacha, mediana va diapazonni hisoblaysiz, standart og‘ish bo‘yicha ikki to‘plamni taqqoslaysiz va nuqtali grafikdagi eng yaxshi mos chiziqni izohlaysiz.
O‘sha paytda jarayon: will be sleeping.
O‘shanda hech kim uning bosh vazir bo‘lishini bilmasdi.
O‘sishdan keyin to‘xtadi — level off; “soared up” va “plummeted sharply” da ortiqcha so‘z bor.
O‘smirlar kattalarga qaraganda internetda ko‘proq vaqt o‘tkazishga moyil.
O‘tgan dam olish kuni bobom va buvimnikiga bordim.
O‘tgan dam olish kunlari haqida 3–4 ta gap yozing; noto‘g‘ri fe’llarni ishlating.
O‘tgan dam olish kunlari nima qildingiz?
O‘tgan davomiy zamon: I was walking
O‘tgan hafta havo juda issiq edi.
O‘tgan haftada {0}-o‘rin ({1} ligasi). Yangi hafta boshlandi!
O‘tgan haftada {0}-o‘rin — {1} ligasiga tushdingiz. Bu hafta qaytib chiqing!
O‘tgan kunlar haqida birinchi gaplar: qayerda edingiz, qanday edi, qachon tug‘ilgansiz.
O‘tgan oy e’lon qilingan hisobot aniq tendensiyani ko‘rsatadi.
O‘tgan voqeagacha bo‘lgan tajriba — had never seen.
O‘tgan yili Samarqandga qilgan sayohatim haqida gapirmoqchiman.
O‘tgan zamon va continuous shakllarni vaqt uchun emas, muloyimlik va masofa uchun ishlatasiz (I was wondering, I’d hoped, we were thinking).
O‘tgan zamonda savol va inkor uchun did ishlatiladi — barcha egalar uchun bir xil.
O‘tish og‘ir bo‘lishi mumkin, qayta o‘qitish zarur
O‘tish uchun juda ko‘p ishlagan bo‘lsangiz kerak.
O‘tkazma qilingach, obuna bir necha soniyada o‘zi yoqiladi.
O‘tmish + majhul: to have been caused.
O‘tmish haqida taxmin: must have, can’t have, might have
O‘tmish shart → hozirgi natija: If + had + V3, would + fe’l: If I had taken that job, I would be living in London now.
O‘tmish shart → hozirgi natija: wouldn’t be.
O‘tmish va hozir: used to + fe’l, In the past… whereas nowadays…, compared to my parents’ generation, much more / far less + sifat.
O‘tmish va hozirni taqqoslaysiz (used to, nowadays, compared to) va kelajak haqida ehtiyotkor taxmin qilasiz (are likely to, might, I imagine).
O‘tmishda bo‘lmagan voqea va uning xayoliy natijasi: If I had left earlier, I would have caught the bus. (Erta chiqmadim — avtobusga ulgurmadim.)
O‘tmishda faqat had to: I had to work late yesterday (“musted” yo‘q). Kelajakda: will have to.
O‘tmishda takrorlangan HARAKATlar uchun would ham ishlatiladi — u hikoyaga iliq, xotira ohangini beradi: “Every summer we would go to our grandmother’s village.”

O‘tmishda: was / were to + fe’l — keyinroq bo‘lgan voqea (taqdir): “He was to become the country’s first astronaut.” were to have + V3 — reja bo‘lgan, amalga oshmagan: “The bridge was to have opened in May.”
O‘tmishdagi bitta qaroringiz haqida yozing: boshqacha qilganingizda nima bo‘lardi va nimadan afsuslanasiz.
O‘tmishdagi bitta qaroringiz hozirgi hayotingizga qanday ta’sir qilganini 3 ta aralash shart gap bilan yozing.
O‘tmishdagi kelajak: was going to, would, was about to
O‘tmishdagi qarorlarni baholash: nima qilish kerak edi, nima shart emas edi, kim nimaga ruxsat berdi.
O‘tmishdagi qobiliyat va imkoniyatni could / couldn’t bilan aytasiz va so‘raysiz.
O‘tmishdagi shartning hozirgi natijasini va hozirgi holatning o‘tmishdagi natijasini aralash shart gaplar bilan ifodalaysiz.
O‘tmishdagi takroriy harakatlar uchun would’ni, holatlar uchun faqat used to’ni ishlatib, xotira hikoya qilasiz.
O‘tmishdagi xayoliy holat va natijalar haqida If + Past Perfect, would have + V3 bilan, afsusni I wish + Past Perfect bilan aytasiz.
O‘tmishdagi xayoliy natija: would have won.
O‘tmishdagi xayoliy shart: Had + ega + V3.
O‘tmishdan qaraganda kelajak bo‘lgan voqealar: was / were going to — reja (ko‘pincha amalga oshmagan): “I was going to call you, but my phone died.”
O‘tmishga afsus: wish + Past Perfect. I wish I had studied harder.

O‘xshash uchburchaklar: burchaklari teng bo‘lsa, mos tomonlar nisbati teng (k). Yuzalar nisbati k², hajmlar nisbati k³. Masalan, tomonlari 2 : 3 nisbatda bo‘lsa, yuzalari 4 : 9. Savolda “mos tomon” larni to‘g‘ri juftlang (eng kichik burchak qarshisidagi tomon — eng kichik tomon).
O‘z shahringiz yoki ishingiz haqida 3 ta gap yozing: It is/was … that/who … va What … is … tuzilmalarini ishlating.

O‘zbek maqolini so‘zma-so‘z tarjima qilmang: “bir o‘q bilan ikki quyon” inglizchada “kill two birds with one stone” (quyon va o‘q emas — qush va tosh!). IELTS essesida maqol ishlatmang — u yerda siyqa (cliché) eshitiladi; Speaking’da esa bitta o‘rinli maqol tabiiy jaranglaydi.

O‘zbek o‘quvchilar ko‘pincha E va I, G va J harflarini adashtiradi: E — [i:], I — [ay]; G — “ji:”, J — “jey”. Yana bir qoida: ism, familiya, shahar va davlat nomi doim katta harf bilan yoziladi: Aziz Karimov, Tashkent, Uzbekistan. Xato qilsangiz ham qo‘rqmang — mashq qilgan sari oson bo‘ladi!

O‘zbek o‘quvchilarining odatiy xatolari: “Some people say…, but they are wrong” (juda keskin va norasmiy); “In my opinion, I think” (takror); “Although …, but …” (although va but bir gapda kelmaydi — bittasini tanlang). Raddiyadan so‘ng abzasni o‘z pozitsiyangizga qaytarib yakunlang: “Therefore, the advantages of … remain more significant.”

O‘zbek o‘quvchilarining odatiy xatosi — idiomani so‘zma-so‘z tarjima qilish yoki o‘xshash iboralarni aralashtirish: “We are on the same side” — “bir tarafdamiz” (boshqa ma’no). Idiomadagi fe’l zamon bo‘yicha o‘zgaradi (She got the ball rolling), qolgan so‘zlar esa o‘zgarmaydi.
O‘zbek tilida bular qo‘shimcha (-da, -ning yonida) bilan beriladi, ingliz tilida esa so‘zdan OLDIN keladi: “the bank next to”, emas “next to the bank”.

O‘zbek tilida muloyimlik ko‘pincha “-sangiz”, “iltimos” bilan beriladi; inglizchada esa savol shakli + please kerak. Buyruq shakli (“Give me the pen”) notanish odamga qo‘pol eshitilishi mumkin. Xato: “Could you to help me?” — could dan keyin to qo‘yilmaydi.

O‘zbek tilida unlining uzun-qisqaligi ma’noni o‘zgartirmaydi, ingliz tilida esa o‘zgartiradi: ship (kema) — sheep (qo‘y), live (yashamoq) — leave (ketmoq). Yana: ba’zi harflar umuman o‘qilmaydi: know (k), write (w), hour (h). Sekin-sekin, ovoz chiqarib takrorlang — quloq tez o‘rganadi.

O‘zbek tilida yo‘q ikkita tovush bor: th. Tilning uchini tishlar orasiga qo‘ying va havo chiqaring: think, three, thank (/θ/). Ovoz bilan aytilsa: this, mother, the (/ð/). “Tank you”, “sink” deyish — eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato.
O‘zbek tilida “-lar” qo‘shamiz, ingliz tilida esa ko‘pincha -s: a book → two books, a sister → three sisters.

O‘zbek tilida “qilmoq” deyarli hamma narsa bilan keladi: xato qilmoq, uy vazifasini qilmoq, harakat qilmoq. Ingliz tilida bu vazifani to‘rt fe’l bo‘lishadi va ularni mantiq bilan emas, tayyor birikma sifatida yodlash kerak. Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xatolar: “do a mistake” (to‘g‘risi make a mistake), “make homework” (do homework), “make a photo” (take a photo), “make an exam” (take an exam).

O‘zbek tilidagi “juda” ingliz tilida ko‘pincha “very” bo‘lib qoladi va nutq bir xil eshitiladi. Ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar esa sifatga qarab ma’lum ravishni tanlaydi: highly + likely / unlikely / effective / qualified / recommended; deeply + concerned / moved / rooted; widely + available / accepted / used; bitterly + disappointed / cold; fully / well + aware; entirely / completely + different.

O‘zbek tilidan kalka qilingan xatolar: “solve the threat” (xavf hal qilinmaydi: reduce / eliminate a threat), “do measures” (take measures — “chora ko‘rmoq”), “give attention” (pay attention), “increase the awareness” (raise awareness). Fe’l va ot bir-biriga “yopishgan”, shuning uchun sinonim bilan almashtirib bo‘lmaydi: “carry a threat” yoki “build the gap” deyilmaydi.
O‘zbek va rus tillarida gapira olaman, lekin ingliz tilim unchalik yaxshi emas.
O‘zbekchada joy so‘zi gap oxirida (“stol ustida”), inglizchada esa predlog OLDIN keladi: “on the table”. “Uyda” — “at home” (in home emas). Devordagi rasm — “on the wall” (devorning sirtida).
O‘zbekchada qo‘shimcha so‘z oxiriga qo‘shiladi, inglizchada esa predlog gap oxirida “osilib” turadi — bu tabiiy. Predlogni tushirib qoldirmang: “Who are you waiting?” — xato.
O‘zbekchada “Sovuq.” deyish yetadi, ingliz tilida esa gapda ega bo‘lishi shart. Shuning uchun it ishlatiladi: It’s cold. It’s sunny. It’s windy. “Is cold” — xato.
O‘zbekchada “Uning sochi uzun” deymiz — inglizchada ikki yo‘l bor: Her hair is long. yoki She has got long hair. Sifatlar tartibi: avval uzunlik, keyin rang — long black hair, short brown hair.

O‘zbekchadagi “roziman”, “qo‘shilaman” so‘zlari ta’sirida ko‘p o‘quvchi “I am agree” deydi. Aslida agree — fe’l: I agree. I don’t agree (I am not agree emas). Kim bilan: agree with + odam / fikr (I agree with you). Nimaga: agree that + gap (I agree that it’s too expensive).

O‘zbekiston aholisi taxminan o‘ttiz olti million.
O‘zbekistonda tog‘lar, daryolar va cho‘llar bor.
O‘zgarish saqlangach darhol ishlaydi va jurnalga yoziladi.
O‘zgarish: fe’l + ravish yoki sifat + ot
O‘zgarishlar avval qoralama bo‘lib saqlanadi; o‘quvchilar faqat “E’lon qilish”dan keyin ko‘radi. O‘chirilgan (arxivlangan) dars tiklanishi mumkin.
O‘zingiz haqida 4 gap yozing: nimani tashlagansiz, kimga qaraysiz, kim bilan yaxshi chiqishasiz (kamida 3 ta phrasal verb).
O‘zingiz haqida hozir: wish + Past Simple (were).
O‘zingiz haqingizda o‘lchamlar bilan 4 gap yozing: bo‘yingiz, uyingizdan maktab yoki ishgacha masofa, kuniga qancha suv ichasiz.
O‘zingiz haqingizda yozing: qayerdansiz, millatingiz va qaysi tillarda gapirasiz.
O‘zingiz haqingizda yozing: yoshingiz, telefon raqamingiz (o‘ylab topilgan) va bitta narsangizning narxi. Sonlarni so‘z bilan yozing.
O‘zingiz haqingizda — afsus, boshqalar haqida — tanqid. ought to have + V3 xuddi shu ma’noda, biroz rasmiyroq. Talaffuzda: should’ve /ʃʊdəv/ (should of deb yozilmaydi!).
O‘zingiz yolg‘iz qilgan ish va do‘stingiz bilan bir-biringizga qanday yordam berishingiz haqida 3–4 gap yozing.
O‘zingizni tanishtiring: ismingiz va familiyangizni yozing, keyin ularni harflab yozing (masalan: A-Z-I-Z).
O‘zingizni tanishtiring: ismingiz, yoshingiz va qayerdan ekaningiz (3–4 ta gap).
O‘zingizni tanishtirish: qayerdansiz, qaysi tillarda gapirasiz, anketani to‘ldirish va yangi tanish bilan qisqa suhbat.
O‘zingizni yoki do‘stingizni tasvirlang: soch va ko‘z rangi, qo‘l va oyoq haqida 3–4 gap (have / has).
O‘zingizning haqiqiy rasmingiz — yuz aniq ko‘rinsin (JPG, PNG, WebP)
Palov uchun guruch va ikkita piyoz kerak.

Parabola y = ax² + bx + c: a > 0 bo‘lsa yuqoriga, a < 0 bo‘lsa pastga ochiladi; uchi x = −b / (2a) da. Vertex shakli y = a(x − h)² + k: uchi (h, k), simmetriya o‘qi x = h. x-kesishmalar (zeros) = tenglama yechimlari; y-kesishma = c. Savol “minimum / maximum value” bo‘lsa — uchining y qiymati (k).

Paragraf tuzilishi: (1) asosiy gap — “I live in Tashkent.” (2) 2–3 ta tafsilot — “It is a big city. There are many parks.” (3) yakuniy gap — “I love my city.” Gaplarni and, but, because bilan bog‘lang.

Parallel chiziqlarning qiyaligi teng; perpendikulyar chiziqlarning qiyaliklari ko‘paytmasi −1 ga teng (m₁ · m₂ = −1; teskari va qarama-qarshi ishorali). Gorizontal chiziq y = c (qiyalik 0); vertikal chiziq x = c (qiyalik aniqlanmagan). Nuqta chiziqda yotadimi — koordinatalarini tenglamaga qo‘yib tekshiring.
Parallel — teng qiyalik; perpendikulyar — teskari va qarama-qarshi ishorali.
Parallel: hammasi to + fe’l, hammasi -ing, hammasi sifat. Xato: aralash shakllar.

Parallellik: ro‘yxat yoki qiyoslashdagi bo‘laklar bir xil grammatik shaklda: “She likes reading, writing and painting.” (hammasi -ing), “to read, to write, to paint”. Xato: “She likes reading, to write and painting.” Qiyoslashda ham: “faster than driving” emas, “faster than driving a car”… Bir turdagi narsa bilan bir turdagi narsani solishtiring: “The climate of Tashkent is milder than that of Moscow.”
Paraphrase bu yerda ayniqsa kuchli: bayonot odamning so‘zlarini boshqacha aytadi. Ism atrofidagi 2–3 gapni o‘qing — fikr ba’zan ismdan oldin keladi.
Paraphrase usullari: sinonim (big → large, buy → purchase), so‘z turkumini o‘zgartirish (increase → an increase), tuzilmani o‘zgartirish (People built the bridge → The bridge was built).

Paraphrase — IELTS writing kirishi, Use of English “key word transformation” va akademik iqtibosning asosi. Uch vosita: 1) sinonim (rise → increase), 2) so‘z turkumini o‘zgartirish (decided → made a decision; rapidly → rapid), 3) tuzilmani o‘zgartirish (faol → majhul, ot birikmasi, inversion).
Paraphrase: bir xil ma’no — boshqa so‘zlar
Parijda hech bo‘lmaganman. — Men bo‘lganman! Ajoyib joy.
Parol shart emas. Laqabingiz reyting va duellarda ko‘rinadi.
Parolni eslab qoling: uni tiklash hozircha yo‘q.
Part 2 da 150 ga yaqin so‘z kerak
Part 2: kartadagi 4 nuqtaning hammasiga javob bering va 1,5–2 daqiqa gapiring.
Part 3: fikr + sabab + misol, va 'I think'ni 'In my view' kabi almashtiring.

Parvarish fe’llari: feed (ovqat bermoq), walk (sayr qildirmoq), wash (yuvmoq), play with (bilan o‘ynamoq), take to the vet (veterinarga olib bormoq). Takrorlanish: “I feed my cat twice a day.” “We walk the dog every morning.” He / she / it bilan: feeds, walks, washes (wash → washes).
Passiv = be (kerakli zamonda) + fe’lning 3-shakli. Diqqat bajaruvchiga emas, harakatning o‘ziga yoki natijaga qaratiladi: The bridge was built in 1960.
Passiv ma’no — V3: Built in the 15th century, the madrasa is still in use. (= It was built…)
Past Simple tugagan o‘tgan voqealar uchun: yesterday, last week, two days ago, in 2020.
Past Simple — QACHON bo‘lgani aniq yoki so‘z bilan aytilgan: yesterday, last year, in 2019, two days ago, when I was a child. “I have seen him yesterday” — xato; “I saw him yesterday” — to‘g‘ri.
Past continuous va past simple’ni when / while bilan birlashtirib, uzilib qolgan harakatni hikoya qilasiz.
Past continuous — o‘tgan zamondagi aniq bir paytda davom etayotgan harakat: “At 8 o’clock yesterday I was having dinner.” (Kecha soat 8 da kechki ovqat qilayotgan edim.)
Past perfect — amalga oshmagan umid: “I had hoped to finish by Friday, but…” (umid qilgandim, lekin bo‘lmadi). “Did you want…?” — ofitsiantlar va xizmatda ko‘p ishlatiladigan muloyim savol.
Past perfect — hikoya boshlanishidan oldin bo‘lgan voqea, sabab yoki tushuntirish (He had lost his little daughter).
Past simple (asosiy voqealar), past continuous (fon) va past perfect’ni (oldingi voqea) bitta hikoyada birga ishlatasiz.
Past simple — hikoyaning asosiy voqealari ketma-ket (Suddenly a man ran into the shop and shouted).
Paytga kelib + past perfect — By the time.
Paytga kelib… allaqachon — By the time.
Perfect (to have done, having done) va majhul (to be done, being done) infinitiv va gerundlarni seem, appear, deny, regret kabi fe’llardan keyin ishlatasiz.
Perfect gerund — having + V3 — “… qilib bo‘lgach / qilganini”: “Having finished the report, she went home.” “He denied having taken the money.” (taken ham yetarli, having aniqroq).

Perfect infinitiv — to have + V3 — harakat oldinroq bo‘lganini ko‘rsatadi: “He seems to have lost weight.” (u ozganga o‘xshaydi — avval ozgan). seem, appear, be said, be believed, claim, pretend bilan ko‘p.
Phrasal verb = fe’l + kichik so‘z (up, out, on, off, after…). Ma’nosi ko‘pincha alohida so‘zlardan taxmin qilib bo‘lmaydi: give (bermoq) + up = tashlamoq, voz kechmoq.
Piyoda — on foot (by foot emas). Yoki oddiy fe’l bilan: I walk to school. Fe’l bilan ham aytish mumkin: I take the bus. I drive to work.
Placebo guruhida ham shunday: dori ta’siri isbotlanmaydi.
Placebo ham xuddi shunday: dori ta’siri isbotlanmaydi.
Platforma bo‘yicha kuniga bepul ovozli suhbat
Please come to + joy yoki tadbir.
Poyezd ham, avtobus ham arzon, lekin birinchisi tezroq.
Poyezd soat nechada jo‘nashini bilib bera olasizmi?
Poyezd soat nechada jo‘naydi? Oltidan o‘ttizda.
Poyezdda borishni rejalashtirgan edik, lekin aslida avtobus arzonroq.
Poyezdda sayohat qilish samolyotdan ancha tinchroq.
Poytaxt bo‘lgan Toshkentda uch millionga yaqin odam yashaydi.
Pozitsiyangiz butun insho davomida bir xilligini tekshiring.
Pozitsiyani birinchi abzatsdayoq ochiq yozing va oxirigacha o‘zgartirmang.
Predlog oxirida: Who are you talking to?
Predlogdan keyin fe’l -ing shaklida: “They accused him of stealing.” “She succeeded in finding a job.” “I object to being treated like this.”
Predlogdan keyin ham shu shakl: with me, for her, to them. “Come with I” emas — “Come with me”.
Predlogdan keyin har doim -ing: interested in learning, good at speaking, thank you for helping, before leaving.

Predlogdan keyin ot, olmosh yoki fe’lning -ing shakli keladi: She’s good at cooking. I’m worried about him. Tipik xatolar: “good in English” (to‘g‘risi good at English), “angry on me” (to‘g‘risi angry with me), “afraid from dogs” (to‘g‘risi afraid of dogs).

Predloglar: on + sana (on 21st March), in + oy (in March), at + bayram nomi (at Navruz, at New Year). Savol: “When is your birthday?” — “It’s on 5th May.” “How do you celebrate it?” — “We have a big dinner and invite friends.”
Predloglar: rise TO 50% (yakuniy qiymat), rise BY 10% (farq), FROM 40% TO 50%. “Peak AT 80”. Bu predloglar xatosi juda ko‘p uchraydi — sonni yozishdan oldin tekshiring.

Prefer — afzal ko‘rmoq: “I prefer tea to coffee.” (to bilan, than emas). Fe’l bilan: “I prefer swimming to running.” Enjoy (zavqlanmoq) ham -ing bilan: “I enjoy cooking.” Savol: “Which do you prefer, tea or coffee?”

Prefikslar ma’noni o‘zgartiradi: counter- (qarshi): counterproductive; mis- (noto‘g‘ri): misinterpret; over- / under- (ortiq / kam): overestimate, underestimate; out- (o‘zib ketmoq): outnumber, outperform.
Present Perfect = have / has + fe’lning 3-shakli (past participle). U aniq vaqti aytilmagan, hayotda bir paytda bo‘lgan tajribani bildiradi: I have visited Istanbul.
Present Perfect bilan for / since ni davomiylik uchun, already / yet / just ni voqea bo‘lgan-bo‘lmaganini aytish uchun to‘g‘ri ishlatasiz.
Present Perfect passiv: have been signed.
Present Perfect qisqa javobi: No, they haven’t.
Present Perfect va 'for' yoki 'since' bilan gap tuzing.
Present Perfect — vaqt aytilmagan tajriba yoki hozirgi natija: I have lost my keys (hozir kalitim yo‘q). Ko‘pincha ever, never, already, yet, just, so far bilan keladi.
Present Simple odatlar, har kuni takrorlanadigan ishlar va doimiy faktlar uchun ishlatiladi.
Present Simple — odat (I usually walk to work), Present Continuous — hozir (Today I’m taking a taxi). Ba’zi fe’llar (know, like, want, need) odatda -ing olmaydi: I know (“I am knowing” emas).
Present Simple’da savol va inkor uchun yordamchi fe’l kerak: do (I, you, we, they) yoki does (he, she, it).
Present continuous — hozir, shu payt yoki vaqtinchalik: “I’m working at home this week.” “Look! She’s walking to work today.” Belgilari: now, at the moment, today, this week.
Present simple — odat, doimiy holat, fakt: “I work in a bank.” “She usually walks to work.” Belgilari: usually, every day, never.
Present simpleda ha-yo‘q savoli Do (I, you, we, they bilan) yoki Does (he, she, it bilan) dan boshlanadi, asosiy fe’l o‘zgarmaydi: “Do you like tea?” “Does she work here?” (“Does she works” emas).
Present simpleda ha-yo‘q savollarini do / does bilan tuzasiz va qisqa javob berasiz: Yes, I do. No, she doesn’t.
Professoringizga tavsiyanoma so‘rab muloyim email yozing: I was wondering if…, I was hoping…, I had hoped… shakllari bilan.

Prognoz (projection) grafiklarida will ni takrorlash o‘rniga passiv qoliplardan foydalaning: is expected / predicted / projected / forecast to + fe’l: “The population is projected to reach 40 million by 2040.” Ot shakli: “According to the forecast, …”. Xato: “is expected to rising” — to dan keyin fe’lning asl shakli keladi.
Progressingiz hisobda saqlanadi. Qayta kirsangiz, hammasi qaytadi.

Pul bilan bog‘liq fe’llar: earn (ishlab topmoq), spend (sarflamoq), save (yig‘moq, tejamoq), pay (to‘lamoq), cost (turmoq). “I earn five million sum a month.” “She spends a lot of money on clothes.” “I save ten percent of my salary.”
Pul haqida 4 gap yozing: nimaga sarflaysiz va nimaga yig‘asiz.
Pul haqida earn, spend, save, pay, cost fe’llari bilan gapirasiz va nimaga pul sarflashingizni aytasiz.
Pul yetmadi — xarajat kam baholangan: underestimated.
Pullari kam bo‘lishiga qaramay, ular baxtli edi.

Pulni nimaga sarflashingiz: spend money on + narsa — “I spend money on food and transport.” Savollar: “What do you spend money on?” “Do you save money?” “How much does it cost?” — “It costs 50,000 sum.”

Purpose (“maqsad”) savollarida muallif nima uchun yozgan: tanqid (to critique), taklif (to propose), tavsif (to describe a process), taqqoslash (to compare), tushuntirish (to explain). Mantiqiy so‘zlar tuzilmani ko‘rsatadi: however — zid fikr, for example — misol, therefore — xulosa, although — tan olish.
Qabul qilish: “I’d love to!”, “That’s a great idea!”, “Sure, why not?”

Qachon va qayerda: “I watch films at the weekend.” “I read a book before bed.” “I listen to music on my phone.” Listen dan keyin to qo‘yiladi: listen to music. Watch film emas — “watch films” yoki “watch a film”.
Qachondan beri nima qilayotganingiz, nimalar o‘zgargani va o‘zingiz haqingizda gapirish.
Qalin tuman bor edi, shuning uchun ko‘lni ko‘ra olmadik.
Qancha uzoq kutsak, shuncha qimmatga tushadi.
Qanchalik kam shakar yesangiz, o‘zingizni shunchalik sog‘lom his qilasiz.
Qanchalik ko‘p mashq qilsangiz, shunchalik yaxshi gapirasiz.
Qanchalik ko‘p o‘qisangiz, so‘z boyligingiz shunchalik boyiydi.
Qanchalik qimmat bo‘lmasin, men uni sotib olaman.
Qanchalik tez-tez kir yuvasiz? Haftada ikki marta.

Qanchalik tez-tez: every day (har kuni), every week (har hafta), once a week (haftada bir marta), twice a week (haftada ikki marta), three times a month (oyiga uch marta), on Saturdays (shanba kunlari). Odatda gap oxirida keladi: “I clean my room twice a week.”
Qanchalik …, shunchalik …: the more, the better
Qanday his qilyapsiz? His-tuyg‘ular va sog‘lom odatlar
Qani endi chiptalarni oldinroq olgan bo‘lsak!
Qani endi ko‘proq bo‘sh vaqtim bo‘lsa.
Qaniydi, men chet tilini yaxshiroq bilsam.

Qarama-qarshi juftlik va to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri murojaat: “It’s not a cost; it’s an investment.” “Not tomorrow, but today.” “Imagine a city where…” Me’yorida ishlating — har gapda bo‘lsa sun’iy eshitiladi.
Qarama-qarshilik ishoralari: although, however, despite. Because va thus — davomiylik.
Qarama-qarshilik: however, nevertheless, in contrast, on the other hand, but, yet. Boshqalar — misol va natija.
Qaror va reja idiomalari: the ball is in your court, up in the air
Qaror va rejalar haqidagi 5 ta zamonaviy idiomani (the ball is in your court, up in the air, back to the drawing board…) to‘g‘ri shakl va ma’noda ishlatasiz.
Qarshi fikrga javob: It could be argued that… However, this overlooks…
Qarshi fikrni qisman tan olish — Admittedly.
Qarshi fikrni tan olish: On the other hand, …; Having said that, … (shunday bo‘lsa-da); Admittedly, … (tan olish kerakki).
Qattiq rejimlar (18+): ustoz xatolaringiz ustidan kuladi, shaxsiyatga tegmaydi.
Qat’iy ko‘rsatma yoki taqiq: “You are to report to the manager at 9.” “Students are not to use phones during the exam.”

Qavs ochish: a(b + c) = ab + ac; (x + a)(x + b) = x² + (a + b)x + ab. Qisqa ko‘paytirish formulalari SAT da juda ko‘p uchraydi: (x + a)² = x² + 2ax + a²; (x − a)² = x² − 2ax + a²; (x + a)(x − a) = x² − a². Har bir qavsni ikkinchisining hadlariga ko‘paytiring va oxirida o‘xshash hadlarni qo‘shing.
Qaydlarda yo‘q fakt qo‘shish — asosiy xatolardan biri.
Qaydlarda yo‘q ma’lumot qo‘shish — odatiy xato.
Qayerda yashashingiz: “I live in a flat / a house.” Flat — ko‘p qavatli uydagi xonadon, house — alohida uy. Qavat: “on the second floor”. Xonalar soni: “There are three rooms.”
Qayerda yashashingizni, uyingiz qanday ekanini va eng yoqtirgan xonangizni 4–5 gapda aytasiz va yozasiz.
Qayerda, nechta xona, nimasi yoqadi, nega.
Qayerdan ekaningizni (I’m from…), millatingizni (I’m Uzbek) va qaysi tillarda gapirishingizni (I speak…) aytasiz.

Qayerdansiz? — “Where are you from?” — “I’m from Samarkand, in Uzbekistan.” Millatingiz: “What nationality are you?” — “I’m Uzbek.” Tillar: “What languages do you speak?” — “I speak Uzbek, Russian and a little English.”
Qaysi abzatsda muvaffaqiyatsiz loyihaga misol bor?
Qaysi abzatsda qanday ma’lumot borligini va qaysi olim/kompaniya qaysi fikrni aytganini tez topasiz.
Qayta ifoda: Sayyohlar sonida keskin o‘sish kuzatildi.
Qayta ifoda: Ta’limga ko‘proq sarmoya hukumatning ustuvor vazifasi bo‘lishi kerak.
Qayta ifodalash: sinonim va so‘z turkumini o‘zgartirish
Qayta so‘rash: Can you repeat that, please?

Qazilma yoqilg‘i, qayta tiklanadigan energiya, uglerod izi, davlat siyosati.
Qilish kerak edi: should have done
Qimmat edi, lekin tasdiqlandi — qarama-qarshilik: However, Nevertheless, Even so.
Qishloq joylarda yashovchilar tibbiy xizmatdan kamroq foydalana oladi.
Qishloqdan shaharga ko‘chish, dehqonchilik, oziq-ovqat xavfsizligi.
Qisman rozilik: I agree up to a point. Tipik xatolar: “I agree to you” (to‘g‘risi agree with you), “I’m agree with you” (am ortiqcha), “You have right” (rus tilidan kalka — to‘g‘risi You’re right).
Qisman rozilik: I see what you mean, but…
Qismlar o‘rnini almashtirish mumkin: We will stay at home if it rains. if bilan boshlansa, o‘rtada vergul qo‘yiladi. unless = if … not: Unless you hurry, you’ll miss the bus.
Qisqa gaplarni and, but, or, because, so bilan bog‘lab, bosh harf va tinish belgilari bilan kichik matn yozish.
Qisqa gaplarni bog'lash (Coherence) bandni oshiradi. 'make pollution' o'rniga 'cause pollution' to'g'riroq.
Qisqa hikoya yozing (5–6 gap): fon (was -ing), asosiy voqealar (V2) va oldingi voqea (had + V3).
Qisqa ijobiy javob: Yes, they are.
Qisqa inkor javob: No, she doesn’t.
Qisqa inkor javob: No, she hasn’t.
Qisqa javob savoldagi fe’l bilan: No, I couldn’t.

Qisqa javob savoldagi yordamchi fe’lni takrorlaydi: “Are you…? — Yes, I am.” “Can you…? — Yes, I can.” “Have you got…? — Yes, I have.” “Do you…? — Yes, I do.” Inkor ham shunday: isn’t, can’t, haven’t, don’t.
Qisqa javob: “Yes, I am.” / “No, I’m not.” Ijobiy qisqa javobda qisqartma ishlatilmaydi: “Yes, I’m.” — xato.
Qisqa javob: “Yes, I was.” / “No, I wasn’t.” “Yes, they were.” / “No, they weren’t.”

Qisqa javobda asosiy fe’l takrorlanmaydi, do / does takrorlanadi: “Yes, I do.” / “No, I don’t.” “Yes, he does.” / “No, he doesn’t.” (“Yes, I like” emas). To be bilan savol alohida: “Are you a student?” — “Yes, I am.”
Qisqa matn xabarlarini o‘qiysiz va yozasiz (I’m on my way. See you at 6.), xabarlarga javob berasiz va qisqartmalarni (pls, thx) bilasiz.
Qisqa matnlar va sodda savollar — formatni o‘rganamiz
Qisqa parchaning asosiy fikrini aniqlaysiz va aniq ma’lumot savoliga matn bo‘yicha javob topasiz; ortiqcha tor yoki keng variantlarni rad etasiz.

Qisqa savol-javob: “Do you like pizza?” — “Yes, I do.” / “No, I don’t.” “Does she like music?” — “Yes, she does.” / “No, she doesn’t.” Javobni boyitish uchun gap qo‘shing: “Yes, I do. I love Italian food.”
Qisqa savolga 2–3 gaplik javob berasiz: javob + sabab + misol yoki tafsilot (bir so‘zli “Yes/No” emas).

Qisqa sifatlar: -er / -est: cheap → cheaper → the cheapest. Uzun sifatlar: more / the most: expensive → more expensive → the most expensive. Taqqoslashda than ishlatiladi: The train is cheaper than the plane.
Qisqa sifatlarga -er qo'shiladi: tall → taller, keyin 'than'.
Qisqa sifatlarning qiyosiy darajasida -er qo'shiladi, 'more' kerak emas.

Qisqa tasvir tartibi: (1) qayerda yashaysiz — “I live in a flat in Tashkent.” (2) xonalar — “There are three rooms and a small kitchen.” (3) sevimli xona — “My favourite room is the living room. It is big and bright.” Gaplarni and bilan bog‘lashingiz mumkin.
Qisqa va aniq gap uzun va buzuq gapdan yaxshi.
Qisqa vaqtda ko‘p narsa o‘rganiladi, boshida qiyin.

Qisqa xabarlar: “I’m on my way.” (yo‘ldaman), “See you at 6.” (soat 6 da ko‘rishamiz), “Can you call me back?” (menga qayta qo‘ng‘iroq qila olasizmi?), “I’m at home.” “I’m late.” Xabar qisqa, lekin to‘liq fikr beradi.

Qisqa xat tuzilishi: salomlashish (Hi Emma, / Hello!), o‘zingiz haqingizda 3–4 gap, yakun (Write soon! / Best wishes,) va ismingiz. because dan keyin to‘liq gap keladi: because it is interesting (because interesting emas).
Qisqalik va aniqlik: ortiqcha so‘zlarni olib tashlash
Qisqartmalar ishlatilmaydi: don’t → do not, can’t → cannot. “I think” o‘rniga ba’zan: It could be argued that…, In my view…
Qisqartmalar yo‘q (do not, it is, cannot)
Qisqasi: “Researchers believe the effect is small.”
Qiyalik teng, kesishma farq qiladi: parallel.
Qiyalik va kesishma bilan y = mx + b ni tuzasiz, grafikni va jadvalni o‘qiysiz, parallel va perpendikulyar chiziqlarni topasiz va masaladagi m, b ma’nosini izohlaysiz.
Qiyalik — har bir birlikka taxminiy o‘sish.
Qiyalik — har bir qo‘shimcha soat uchun taxminiy o‘sish.
Qiyaliklar turlicha bo‘lsa — bitta yechim: (1) va (3). (2), (5) parallel; (4) bir xil chiziq.
Qiyin savol turlari va 60 daqiqani to‘g‘ri taqsimlash — 6.5+ band uchun zarur ko‘nikmalar.
Qiyin savollarni belgilang va keyin qayting.
Qiyin tovushlar: th, w / v, qisqa va uzun unlilar
Qiyosiy daraja + than: taller than, more interesting than.
Qizil va oqni aralashtirsangiz, pushti rang chiqadi.
Qiziq voqeani hikoya qilish: nima bo‘layotgan edi, birdan nima bo‘ldi, keyin nima qildingiz.
Qog‘ozdagi imtihonda oxirida javoblarni ko‘chirish uchun 10 daqiqa beriladi; kompyuterda esa faqat 2 daqiqa tekshirish vaqti bor. Imlo va grammatika baholanadi: noto‘g‘ri yozilgan so‘z — 0 ball.

Qoida some / any dagidek: darak gapda some- (I heard something), inkor va savolda any- (I didn’t see anyone. Is there anything to eat?). no- ning o‘zi inkor ma’nosini beradi: There is nothing in the fridge = There isn’t anything in the fridge.
Qoida tushuntirishi, misollar, mashqlar… Savollar formatda bo‘lsa (? … | *to‘g‘ri | izoh), AI ularni o‘zgartirmasdan oladi.
Qoida yangilandi — yoqish uchun «Yoqish» tugmasini bosing

Qoida: savolda faqat BITTA yordamchi fe’l bo‘ladi. Shuning uchun xato gaplar: “Do you are a student?” emas “Are you a student?”; “Do you can swim?” emas “Can you swim?”; “Do you have got a car?” emas “Have you got a car?” yoki “Do you have a car?”
Qora paltoli novcha erkak zargarlik oynasiga qarab turgan
Qoralama saqlandi, lekin {0} ta xato bor — e’lon qilishdan oldin tuzating.
Qornim juda och — kun bo‘yi hech narsa yemadim.
Qorong‘i tushayotgan edi va biz mehmonxonaga qaytayotgan edik.
Qotib qolganda: vaqt yutish va tushuntirish
Qotib qolsangiz, taxmin qiling va davom eting.
Qo‘limdan kelsa yordam berardim, lekin kelmaydi.

Qo‘llab-quvvatlash va zaiflashtirish: supports — da’voni kuchaytiruvchi dalil; weakens — unga zid yoki unga muqobil tushuntirish beruvchi dalil. Ekstremal da’vo (all, always, never, proves) uchun dalil ham to‘liq bo‘lishi kerak; “some”, “often” kabi yumshoq da’voga bitta dalil yetadi.
Qo‘mita qarorni keyinga qoldirishga qaror qildi.
Qo‘ng‘iroq uchun rahmat. Tushlikdan keyin sizga qayta qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman.
Qo‘shilish va e’tiroz: I agree, I’m not sure about that
Qo‘shilmasangiz — qisqa javob: “I love tea.” — “I don’t.” “I can’t drive.” — “I can.” Yordamchi fe’l gapdagiga mos bo‘lishi shart.
Qo‘shimcha ma’lumot (non-defining) gap vergullar bilan ajratiladi va unda that ishlatilmaydi: Samarkand, which is over 2,500 years old, is a UNESCO site.

Qo‘shimcha: raqam, sana va nom detail savollarida aniq tekshiriladi; “most nearly” kabi so‘zlar darajani bildiradi. Agar ikki variant ham to‘g‘ri tuyulsa, qaysi biri savolga to‘g‘ridan to‘g‘ri javob berayotganini (va matnda ham aniq turganini) tanlang.
Qo‘shma sifat ikki so‘zdan defis bilan yasaladi va bitta tushunchani ixcham beradi: “a job that pays well” → “a well-paid job”.

Quantitative evidence (jadval va grafik): avval sarlavha, o‘qlar, birliklar va legendani o‘qing. Savol “Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to…” bo‘lsa, da’voga mos AYNAN SHU kategoriya va yil/qiymatni oling; taqqoslash so‘zlari (more than, half, twice, decreased) ni raqamlar bilan tekshiring. Tuzoq: raqam grafikda bor, lekin boshqa kategoriyaga tegishli.
Question tag — gap oxirida “shundaymi?, to‘g‘rimi?” ma’nosidagi qisqa savol. Ijobiy gapdan keyin inkor tag: “It’s cold, isn’t it?” Inkor gapdan keyin ijobiy tag: “You don’t smoke, do you?”
Qurding-u, o‘zing buzding! Jim turgandan ko‘ra “Well, actually…” de!
Quruvchilar ishni yengil-yelpi qilishdi, endi tom chakkalaydi.
Qushning ikkita qanoti bor va u uchadi.
Quyidagi Reading & Writing va Math savollari — izohlar bilan.
Quyidagi gapni 2 xil usulda qayta yozing va qaysi vositalarni ishlatganingizni yozing: “Many young people move to big cities because they want better jobs.”
Quyidagi og‘zaki matnni akademik uslubda qayta yozing: “Lots of young people don’t get jobs, and prices went up a lot, so life got really hard.”
Rad etish: I’m afraid I can’t.

Raddiya darajalari: to‘liq rad etish (This claim does not stand up to scrutiny), qisman (This is only partly true), ustunlik (The benefits far outweigh this drawback). Raddiyada albatta sabab yoki dalil bo‘lsin: faqat “I disagree” deb qo‘yilgan fikr Task Response’da “rivojlantirilmagan” deb baholanadi va band 6 dan oshmaydi.
Raddiya: this view fails to recognise…

Radian: 180° = π radian, shuning uchun 1° = π/180 rad; 90° = π/2; 60° = π/3; 45° = π/4; 30° = π/6. Radiandan gradusga: ko‘paytiring 180/π ga. Yoy uzunligi radianda: s = rθ. Eng ko‘p xato — kalkulyator rejimi (degree / radian). SAT Desmos kalkulyatori bilan: rejimni tekshiring.
Rang -s olmaydi va otdan oldin keladi: blue pens.
Rang otdan OLDIN keladi: a red pen (pen red emas). Rang hech qachon -s olmaydi: two blue pens (blues pens emas). Rangni so‘rash: What colour is it? — It’s green.
Rang otdan oldin va -s olmaydi: blue eyes.
Rang otdan oldin: a red umbrella. red — undosh, shuning uchun a.
Rang “is” dan keyin ham keladi: My bag is green.
Raqam bor, lekin da’voga tegishli emas.
Raqamlarda aniq bo‘ling: “taxminan uchdan bir” “ko‘p”dan yaxshi.

Raqamni har gal foiz bilan takrorlamang: 25% = a quarter, 33% = a third, 50% = half, 75% = three quarters; 55–60% = a (small) majority; 10% = one in ten. Yuqori bandli javoblar raqam va so‘zni aralashtiradi: “Just over a third of students (34%) cycled to school.”
Raqamsiz — percentage; percent faqat raqam bilan.
Rasmiy miqdor iboralari: a great deal of, the vast majority
Rasmiy munozara: fikrni bildirish, qarshi dalilga javob berish iboralari — Speaking Part 3 uchun ideal namuna.
Rasmiy natija uchun 4 ta ko‘nikma bali kerak (0–9, 0.5 qadam).
Rasmiy nisbiy iboralar: whereby, in which case, the extent to which
Rasmiy reja va ko‘rsatma: The minister is to visit…

Rasmiy uslub: lotin kelib chiqishli fe’llar, ot birikmalari, majhul nisbat, qisqartmasiz: “It is necessary to ascertain the reasons for the decline in sales.” Juftlar: find out → ascertain / discover, go up → increase, put off → postpone, get → obtain, look into → investigate, set up → establish, ask for → request.

Rasmiy uslub: qisqartmalar yo‘q (don’t → do not), og‘zaki so‘zlar o‘rniga rasmiylari: get → obtain/receive, a lot of → a significant number of / a great deal of, big → considerable, show → demonstrate.
Rasmiy uslubda if tushirib qoldirilib, yordamchi fe’l gap boshiga chiqadi.
Rasmiy uslubda suggest, recommend, insist, demand, require + that + ega + fe’lning asosiy shakli: The doctor recommended that he rest. (rests emas!)
Rasmiy xatlar, akademik matn va murakkab munozarada fikrni nozik farqlar bilan ifodalash: shart inversiyasi, aralash shart gaplar va kuchli kollokatsiyalar.
Rasmiy yozuv, nutq va taqdimotlarda fikrni kuchli va aniq ifodalash: inversiya, ta’kidlovchi (cleft) gaplar va akademik uslub.
Rasmiy, ammo tabiiy ohang: o‘zingizni tanishtirish va kuchli tomonlarni aytish iboralariga e’tibor bering.
Rasmiy: Iltimos, ish vaqtini aniqlab bera olasizmi?
Rasmni tasavvur qiling: notanish odamning xonasi (kitoblar, gitara, sport kiyimi). U haqida 4 ta xulosa yozing (must / can’t / might).
Ravish + sifat birikmalari: highly unlikely, deeply concerned

Ravonlik — tez gapirish emas. Bir maromda, kerakli joyda to‘xtab, o‘zingizni tuzatsangiz ham davom etish. Nutq tezligidan ko‘ra bog‘langanlik muhimroq.

Reading bo‘limining tuzilishi, vaqti va asosiy qoidalarini bilib olasiz — imtihonda kutilmagan narsa qolmaydi.
Reading va Listening darajangizni alohida baholaydi.
Reading va Listening — rasmiy hajm va vaqt bilan. Xatolar izohi bilan.

Reflexive olmoshlarni (myself, herself, themselves) va each other ni to‘g‘ri ishlatasiz.
Reja ish beradimi yo‘qmi — buni vaqt ko‘rsatadi.

Reja rad etildi — boshidan boshlaymiz: back to the drawing board.
Reja sizning real darajangizga qurilishi uchun avval daraja testini topshiring.
Reja so‘rash: What are you doing…?
Reja tuzing, asosiy vazifani tanlang, fe’lni tekshiring, ekstremal so‘zlardan ehtiyot bo‘ling. “Matnda bor” kifoya emas.
Reja va tayyorgarlik bor: is going to.
Reja: 1-matn ~17 daqiqa, 2-matn ~20 daqiqa, 3-matn ~23 daqiqa. Oson matnda vaqt tejab, qiyin matnga ko‘proq qoldiring. Har matn tugaganda soatga qarang.
Rejadagi ish: be having + narsa + V3.
Rejani so‘rash: What are you doing this weekend? Are you doing anything tonight?
Respondentlarning aksariyati onlayn bankni afzal ko‘rgan.
Reys bekor qilindi, lekin buning yaxshi tomoni — Samarqandda yana bir kun qoldik.
Reys bekor qilindi, shuning uchun aeroportda qolishga majbur bo‘ldik.
Reys kechiksa, yo‘lovchilarga ovqat taloni beriladi.
Reytingda hozircha hech kim yo‘q (faqat ruxsat bergan hamkorlar ko‘rinadi).
Reytingda qatnashish uchun hisobingizga kiring. Laqabingiz reytingda ko‘rinadi.

Rhetorical synthesis savolida 3–5 ta qisqa qayd (bullet points) va bitta maqsad beriladi: “The student wants to emphasize a difference between …” yoki “to introduce … to an audience unfamiliar with …”. Avval MAQSADni aniq belgilang (nimani ta’kidlash, kim uchun), keyin qaydlardan faqat shu maqsadga kerakli faktlarni ajrating.

Rim ham, Parij ham go‘zal, lekin ikkinchisi qimmatroq.

Ritorik savol, uchlik qoidasi (rule of three) va qarama-qarshi juftliklar bilan nutqingizni ta’sirli qilasiz.
Riverside Fitness Centre — New Member Form. Qo‘ng‘iroq: yangi a’zo va resepshn xodimi.
Rostini aytsam, film biroz zerikarli edi.
Rostini aytsam, ijtimoiy tarmoqlarni unchalik yoqtirmayman.
Rostini aytsam, unchalik emas. Televizordan ko‘ra kitob o‘qishni afzal ko‘raman.

Rozilik: I agree, exactly, that’s true, good point. E’tiroz: I’m not sure, I see what you mean, but…, I don’t think so, that might be a problem. “I see what you mean, but…” — ko‘pincha ROZI EMAS degani.
Rozilik: supports, complements, extends. Refutes va challenges — zid.

SAT Reading & Writing: so‘z ma’nosi va matn tuzilishi

SAT da ma’nosi bir xil bo‘lgan variantlar orasida odatda eng QISQA va aniq javob to‘g‘ri bo‘ladi — agar u grammatik to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa. Ortiqchalik turlari: takror (“past history”, “revert back”, “end result”, “free gift”, “each and every”, “completely eliminate”) va bo‘sh iboralar (“due to the fact that” → because, “at this point in time” → now, “in order to” → to).

SAT da tez-tez uchraydigan uch holat: (1) bitta yechim — x oldidagi koeffitsientlar teng emas; (2) yechim yo‘q — soddalashtirgach 0 = 5 kabi yolg‘on tenglik chiqadi (x lar ikki tomonda teng, erkin hadlar boshqa); (3) cheksiz ko‘p yechim — 0 = 0 chiqadi. “Which value of k gives no solution?” savolida x oldidagi koeffitsientlarni tenglang, erkin hadlarni teng QILMANG.

SAT dagi “Boundaries” savollari gap chegarasini tekshiradi. Mustaqil gap (independent clause) — ega + kesim bor va o‘zi fikr tugatadi: “It rained.” Ikki mustaqil gapni to‘rt xil to‘g‘ri ulash mumkin: (1) nuqta — “It rained. We stayed home.” (2) nuqta-vergul — “It rained; we stayed home.” (3) vergul + FANBOYS (for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so) — “It rained, so we stayed home.” (4) bo‘ysunish — “Because it rained, we stayed home.”
SD son qo‘shilganda o‘zgarmaydi; bog‘liqlik sababni isbotlamaydi.
SD: tarqoqlik; son qo‘shish SD ni o‘zgartirmaydi
Sabab + ot / -ing: because of, due to, owing to, as a result of: Flights were cancelled due to the storm. Xato: “due to it was raining” — keyin gap kelmaydi (due to the fact that … mumkin).
Sabab + to‘liq gap: because, since, as: Since the price rose, demand fell.
Sabab ham, oqibat (yoki yechim) ham yozilgan
Sabab sifatida faktni hisobga olish: given that / considering that — “… ni hisobga olsak”: “Given that prices are rising, people are saving less.”
Sabab va natija: because, because of, so
Sabab va natija: due to, consequently, therefore
Sabab va oqibatni adashtirmang: sabab "nega bo‘layapti", oqibat "nima bo‘ladi".

Sabab: because + to‘liq gap (ega + fe’l): I stayed at home because it was raining. because of + ot yoki olmosh: I stayed at home because of the rain. Ma’no bir xil, tuzilma esa boshqa. Bu o‘zbek o‘quvchilarining eng ko‘p xatosi: “because of it was raining” yoki “because the rain” — ikkalasi ham xato.
Sababni because (chunki), natijani so (shuning uchun) bilan aytasiz va Why? savoliga javob berasiz.
Sabrli va qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi. Xatoni yumshoq tuzatadi, qisqa gaplar bilan gapiradi.
Sahnani o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan 2–3 gapda gapirib bering. Matnni ko‘rmasdan, asosiy g‘oyalarni eslang.
Sahnani o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan qayta aytib bering (inglizcha)...
Salom! Bugun sen gapirasan, men kulaman. Tell me, what annoys you the most in your city?

Salom, men Azizman. Tanishganimdan xursandman. — Men ham xursandman.
Sammit iyunda bo‘lishi kerak edi, lekin keyinga qoldirildi.

Sana va vaqt: “5th May” yoki “May 5”; “6 p.m.” (kechki 6), “9 a.m.” (ertalab 9). Kimdan — “From”, kimga — “To”. Rad javobda sababni ayting: “Sorry, I can’t. I’m at work.” Taklif uchun minnatdorchilik bildiring: “Thank you for the invitation!”
Sanada tartib son ishlatiladi: 1st first, 2nd second, 3rd third, 4th fourth, 5th fifth, 12th twelfth, 20th twentieth, 21st twenty-first.
Sanaladigan ko'plik otlar bilan 'many' ishlatiladi (much emas).
Sanaladigan ot bilan: twice as many … as.
Sanaladigan otlar (apple, bottle, ticket) ko‘plik oladi va how many bilan so‘raladi: How many tickets do you need?
Sanaladigan otlar: an apple, two apples, an egg, three eggs. Ular bilan a/an va ko‘plik -s ishlatiladi.
Sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlarni ajratib, how much / how many va narx so‘rashni to‘g‘ri ishlatasiz.
Sanalar ko‘p shaklda aytiladi: “the third of May”, “May the third”. Javobni bir xil, aniq shaklda yozing: 3 May. Raqamlarni so‘z bilan emas, son bilan yozish xavfsizroq (15, fifteen emas).
Sanalmaydigan narsalarni a bottle of, a piece of, a kilo of kabi birliklar bilan sanaysiz.
Sanalmaydigan ot (water) bilan 'much', sanaladigan ko'plik ot bilan 'many'.
Sanalmaydigan ot bilan fe’l birlikda: “The rice is hot.” Miqdor kerak bo‘lsa — a glass of water, a piece of bread (bu A2 da chuqurroq o‘rganiladi).
Sanalmaydigan otlar (water, rice, bread, money, sugar) ko‘plik olmaydi va how much bilan so‘raladi: How much rice do you want? “breads”, “moneys” — xato.
Sanalmaydigan otlar: water, rice, bread, milk, sugar, money. Ularni “bitta, ikkita” deb sanab bo‘lmaydi: “a rice”, “two breads” — xato.
Sanalmaydigan otni (water, bread, cheese) to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri sanab bo‘lmaydi, lekin idish yoki o‘lchov bilan sanaymiz: a bottle of water, two pieces of bread.
Sanani surish yoki maqsadni pasaytirish kerak.
Sarlavha abzatsning BUTUN mazmunini qamraydi, bitta tafsilotni emas. Abzatsda yil, ism, misol bo‘lishi mumkin — lekin sarlavha ular haqida emas, umumiy fikr haqida.
Sarlavha qismida “Kalit: qiymat” ko‘rinishi kerak (Title, Level, Minutes, Kind)

Sarlavha: “Survey proves coffee makes students smarter”. So‘rovnoma — 200 talaba, bitta universitet, qahva kompaniyasi moliyalashtirgan. Tadqiqotni 4–5 gapda baholang: bitta kuchli tomon va kamida ikki zaiflik.
