Savol berish va javob qaytarish: do / does bilan ha-yo‘q savollari, savol so‘zlari va to‘g‘ri savol shaklini tanlash.
Savol bo‘lsa, shu yerga yozing — jamoamiz javob beradi.
Savol ega haqida bo‘lsa do / does kerak emas, fe’lga -s qo‘shiladi: “Who lives here?” (“Who does live” emas). “What happens?” “Whose bag is this?” — Whose + ot + be.
Savol egani so‘rasa (kim qildi?), do / does / did ishlatilmaydi va gap tartibi o‘zgarmaydi: “Who called you?” (Sizga kim qo‘ng‘iroq qildi?) — javob: “Ali called me.”
Savol fikr so‘rasa, “I believe / in my view” ishlating
Savol qatori T, M, H yoki F harfi bilan boshlanadi
Savol qaysi fe’l bilan tuzilishini bilasiz: be → Are you…?, can → Can you…?, have got → Have you got…?, boshqa fe’llar → Do you…?

Savol shakli gapdagi fe’lga bog‘liq: to be — “Are you a student?” “Is he at home?”; can — “Can you swim?”; have got — “Have you got a car?” “Has she got a phone?”; boshqa barcha fe’llar — do / does: “Do you like tea?” “Does he play chess?”

Savol so‘zi + do / does + ega + fe’l: “Where do you live?” “What time does the lesson start?” “Why do you study English?” “Which bus do you take?” Do / does savol so‘zidan keyin turadi, asosiy fe’l o‘zgarmaydi: “Where does she work?” (“works” emas).
Savol so‘zi har doim gap boshida turadi: What is your name? Where do you live?

Savol so‘zlari: what (nima), where (qayerda), when (qachon), why (nima uchun), who (kim), which (qaysi), whose (kimning), how (qanday). Javob: “In Tashkent.” “At nine.” “Because I want to travel.” “Number 12.”
Savol tartibi oddiy: where I worked.
Savol tartibi: Are + you + a teacher.
Savol tartibi: Do / Does + ega + fe’l + qolgan qism? — “Do they live in Samarkand?” Yozuvda har doim to‘liq savol tuzing; “You like tea?” faqat og‘zaki suhbatda uchraydi.
Savol to‘ldiruvchini so‘rasa (kimni? nimani?), do / does / did kerak: “Who did you call?” (Siz kimga qo‘ng‘iroq qildingiz?) — “I called Ali.”
Savol turlari, usullar va vaqt: bilimingizni ballga aylantiring.
Savol tuzish uchun am / is / are ni egadan oldinga chiqaramiz: “You are a student.” → “Are you a student?”
Savol {0} / {1} · g‘alaba uchun kamida {2} ta to‘g‘ri javob
Savol: Have you ever …? (hech qachon … qilganmisiz?) Javob: Yes, I have. / No, I haven’t. never — “hech qachon” ma’nosida, gap ijobiy shaklda qoladi: I have never tried sushi.
Savol: How do you get to work? How does she get to school? Vaqt: How long does it take? — It takes twenty minutes. Diqqat: home oldidan to qo‘yilmaydi: I go home by bus (to home emas).
Savol: How do you spell + narsa?
Savol: Is + ega (your name) + qolgan qism.
Savol: Is there…? / Are there…? Qisqa javob: Yes, there is. / No, there aren’t.
Savol: was / were egadan oldinga chiqadi. “You were at home.” → “Were you at home?”
Savol: “Should governments make public transport free?” Bitta asosiy abzats yozing (PEEL): mavzu gapi, tushuntirish (This is because…), misol (For example…) va natija.

Savol: “Some people think that all university students should study whatever they like. Others believe they should study subjects useful for the future. Discuss both views and give your opinion.” Kirish yozing: paraphrase + thesis (2–3 gap).

Savol: “Some people think that working from home is better than working in an office. To what extent do you agree?” Fikringizcha xulosa abzatsini yozing (2–3 gap): In conclusion + pozitsiya + ikki asosiy fikr qisqacha.

Savol: “Why?” (nima uchun?) — javob: “Because …” “Why do you study English?” — “Because I want to travel.” Because dan keyin to‘liq gap keladi: “because I want…”, “because it’s sunny”. So oldidan vergul qo‘yiladi.
Savolda 'Do' + ega + fe'l: Do you have ...?
Savolda are egadan oldin keladi: Are you…?
Savolda predlog oxirida qoladi: “What are you looking for?” (Nima qidiryapsiz?) “Where are you from?” “What is this book about?”
Savoldagi so‘zlar matnda boshqacha aytilganini (sinonim, boshqa tuzilma) tanib olasiz.
Savollar: so‘z tartibi oddiy gapdagi kabi bo‘ladi va so‘roq belgisi qo‘yilmaydi: “Where do you live?” → He asked where I lived. Ha/yo‘q savollari uchun if / whether: She asked if I was ready.
Savollar: “How often do you wash the dishes?” — “Every day.” “Who cooks in your family?” — “My mother does.” Takrorlanmaslik uchun fe’l o‘rniga do / does ishlatiladi: “Who washes the dishes? — I do.”

Savollar: “How tall are you?” — “I’m one metre seventy-five.” “How far is it?” — “It’s two kilometres.” “How heavy is it?” — “It’s five kilos.” “How long is the road?” — “It’s a hundred kilometres.” Sifatni How dan keyin qo‘yamiz.
Savollarni o‘qish vaqtida har bo‘sh joy uchun so‘rang: bu yerga ot keladimi, son keladimi, narxmi, kunmi, joymi? “£___” — narx; “at ___ pm” — vaqt; “a ___” — birlik ot; “on ___” — kun yoki sana.
Savolni belgilash (⚑), matnni bo‘yash va eslatma yozish mumkin. Klaviatura: Alt+N / Alt+P / Alt+F.
Saylovda kim g‘alaba qilsa ham, jiddiy muammolarga duch keladi.

Sayohat so‘zlari: ticket (chipta), passport (pasport), luggage (yuk), platform (platforma), gate (chiqish darvozasi), flight (reys), train (poyezd), station (vokzal), airport (aeroport). Single ticket — bir tomonga, return ticket — borib-qaytish chiptasi.
Sayohat — pulni behuda sarflash degan fikrga qo‘shilmayman.
Sayohatdan keyin do‘stingizga qisqa xabar yozing: nima bo‘ldi? (something / someone, anything / anyone, nothing / nobody, everyone / everything dan kamida 2 tasi)
Sayyohlar soni 2 milliondan 5 milliongacha keskin oshdi.
Scanning — aniq narsani qidirish: ism, son, sana, katta harf bilan yozilgan so‘z. Ko‘zingiz matn bo‘ylab “yuguradi”, faqat kerakli joyda to‘xtaysiz va o‘sha gapni diqqat bilan o‘qiysiz.
Sekin boshlaymiz: har bir gapni eshiting, subtitrga qarab takrorlang. Maqsad — ravon va aniq talaffuz.

Sevimli bayramingiz haqida 4–5 gap yozing: qachon nishonlanadi va odamlar nima qiladi.

Sevimli fanni aytish: “My favourite subject is Biology.” So‘rash: “What is your favourite subject?” Dars jadvali: “I have Maths on Monday.” — have shu yerda “darsi bor” degani. Kun oldidan on: on Monday; vaqt oldidan at: at nine o’clock.
Sevimli film, musiqa va kitoblaringiz haqida gapirasiz: My favourite … is…, What kind of … do you like?, It’s funny / boring.
Sevimli filmingiz, musiqangiz yoki kitobingiz haqida 4 ta gap yozing.

Sevimli narsani aytish: “My favourite film is…”, “My favourite singer is…”. So‘rash: “What kind of music do you like?” (qanday musiqani yoqtirasiz?) — “I like pop and classical music.” Janrlar: pop, rock, classical (klassik), folk (xalq), comedy (komediya), action (jangari), horror (qo‘rqinchli), cartoon (multfilm).

Shahringizdagi avtobus yo‘lovchilari soni 2015–2025-yillarda qanday o‘zgarganini tasavvur qilib, 3–4 gaplik Task 1 abzasi yozing: kamida bitta fe’l + ravish va bitta sifat + ot + in.
Shahringizdagi biror bino yoki joy haqida qisqa ma’lumot yozing: qachon qurilgan, nima uchun ishlatiladi (kamida 2 ta passiv gap).
Shahringizdagi o‘zgarishlar haqida qisqa hisobot yozing (4 gap): kamida 3 ta kengaytirilgan ot birikmasi (a rise in…, people living in…, the decision to…).

Shakli to‘g‘ri, lekin essega juda norasmiy.
Shakllar: mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs. Apostrof yo‘q: “yours” (your’s emas).
Shakllari: myself, yourself (birlik) / yourselves (ko‘plik), himself, herself, itself, ourselves, themselves. “hisself” yoki “theirselves” — xato.
Shanba kunlari do‘stlarim bilan futbol o‘ynayman.
Shanba kunlarini yaxshi ko‘raman, chunki ishlamayman.

Sharhlarni o‘qib chiqib, uni sotib olmaslikka qaror qildim.

Shart inversiyasi: Should you…, Were I to…, Had I known…
Shart va natija turli vaqtga tegishli bo‘lsa, aralash shart gap ishlatiladi.
Shart: provided (that) / providing / as long as — “… sharti bilan” (if dan qat’iyroq): “You can borrow my car provided that you return it by six.” Bu bog‘lovchilardan keyin will ishlatilmaydi.
Shartlarni o‘zgartirish: qoidani o‘chiring → «Tahrirlash» → saqlang → qayta yoqing. Eski yozuvlar o‘zgarmaydi.

Shifokor bilan qisqa dialog yozing: shifokor nima bo‘lganini so‘raydi, siz nima og‘riyotganini aytasiz, shifokor maslahat beradi.
Shifokor menga uch kun to‘shakda yotishimni aytdi.

Shifokor yoki do‘stingizga o‘zingizni qanday his qilayotganingizni aytish, maslahat berish va yaqin kelajak rejalarini kelishish.
Shikoyat qilish va yechim so‘rash: xushmuomala, lekin qat’iy ohang.

Shoshilmang, lekin sal tezroq javob berishga harakat qiling.

Sifat (a good singer) va ravish (sings well).
Sifat + ot + in: a significant drop in.
Sifat + ot: heavy traffic, strong evidence, high risk, deep concern, a wide range, a key factor. Ravish + sifat: highly unlikely, deeply concerned, widely recognised.
Sifat + predlog: good at, afraid of, worried about
Sifat hech qachon ko‘plik bo‘lmaydi: “bigs houses” emas — “big houses”.
Sifat ko‘plikda ham o‘zgarmaydi: two big windows.
Sifat otdan oldin va o‘zgarmaydi: a small kitchen.
Sifat otdan oldin: a big house.
Sifat otdan oldin: a big new house.
Sifat otni tasvirlaydi (a careful driver), ravish esa fe’lni — harakat QANDAY bajariladi: He drives carefully.

Sifat yasovchi qo‘shimchalar ma’noni o‘zgartiradi: -ful (bor): useful, careful; -less (yo‘q): useless, careless; -ive / -al: effective, creative, environmental. Imloga e’tibor bering: happy → happiness (y → i), argue → argument (e tushadi). IELTS Writing’da so‘z shakli xatolari Lexical Resource’ni 6 dan yuqoriga chiqarmaydi, shuning uchun tekshirishda har bir uzun so‘zning turkumiga qarang.
Sifatdan ravish yasaysiz (quick → quickly) va harakat qanday bajarilishini tasvirlaysiz.
Sifatdosh oborotlari: Having finished…, Built in…
Sifatni otdan oldin yoki to be dan keyin to‘g‘ri qo‘yasiz va very bilan kuchaytirasiz.

Signposting — ma’ruzachi yangi bo‘limga o‘tayotganini bildiruvchi so‘zlar: First of all, Turning now to, Another important point, However, For example, To sum up. Konspektdagi sarlavhalar shu so‘zlardan keyin keladi.
Simple — natija, tugagan ish, “nechta / necha marta”: “I’ve written three emails.” “She has read the book.” (tugatdi)
Sinfda topilgan narsalar haqida qisqa suhbat yozing: Whose…? savoli va mine/yours/hers bilan javoblar.
Sinfdoshingizga 5 ta savol yozing: kamida bittasi Are you…?, bittasi Can you…?, bittasi Do you…? bilan boshlansin.
Singlim telefon olish uchun hali yosh.

Sinonim deyarli hech qachon 100% teng emas: har birini birikma va uslub bilan tekshiring. problems → issues (to‘g‘ri), lekin children → kids (norasmiy), worried → frightened (ma’no kuchayib ketadi). O‘zbek o‘quvchilar lug‘atdan topilgan “chiroyli” so‘zni qo‘yib, ma’noni buzib qo‘yadi: “The number of tourists has grown” → “The tourist population has expanded” g‘alati eshitiladi.
Sistemani qo‘yish yoki qo‘shish usuli bilan yechasiz, yechimlar sonini (0, 1, cheksiz) aniqlaysiz va ikki noma’lumli so‘zli masalani tuzasiz.
Sister — bitta qiz yoki ayol: she’s.
Sister — qiz yoki ayol, shuning uchun her.

Sizda isitma bor. Yotib dam oling.
Sizga muhim bo‘lgan odam, joy va narsani tasvirlang: who, where, which/that ishlatib 3 ta gap.

So … was the … / Such was the …
Soat bilan at: at one o’clock.

Sog‘lom odatlar: sleep (uxlamoq), drink water (suv ichmoq), eat fruit and vegetables (meva va sabzavot yemoq), do exercise (sport bilan shug‘ullanmoq), walk (yurmoq). “I sleep eight hours a day.” “I drink two litres of water.” “I don’t eat fast food.”
Sog‘lom odatlaringiz haqida 4–5 gap yozing (sleep, drink, eat, exercise, walk dan foydalaning).
Sog‘lom turmush haqida 4 ta “qoida” yozing: zero conditional (If…, …) va kamida bitta unless.
Soliq muxoliflari u kichik bizneslarga zarar yetkazadi, deb ta’kidlaydi.
Son (two) dan keyin ot ko‘plikda: sisters.
Son + ot birlikda, defis bilan: five-year.
Son bilan aniqlik: “just over a quarter” (26%), “nearly half” (48%), “the vast majority” (85%). Foiz va son o‘rtasida farq qiling: the percentage of people, the number of people.
Sonlarda tuzoqlar: “double five” = 55, “oh” = 0 (telefonda). 13 (thirTEEN) va 30 (THIRty) urg‘u bilan farqlanadi. Narx: “twelve fifty” = £12.50.
Sorry, I’m ___. I’m on the bus. (kech)

Sovg‘a berish: give + kim + nima — “I give my mother a flower.” Yoki give + nima + to + kim — “I give a flower to my mother.” Kim o‘rnida olmosh bo‘lsa: give her / him / them / us / me: “I give her a book.”

Sovg‘a haqida so‘rash: “What do you want for your birthday?” — “I’d like a book.” “Do you like it?” — “Yes, I love it!” For — kim uchun: “a present for my sister”. “Thanks” — qisqa, norasmiy “rahmat”.
Sovg‘ani give + kim + nima shaklida aytasiz, tabriklaysiz va minnatdorchilik bildirasiz: Happy birthday! Thank you! You’re welcome.
Sovuq havoga qaramay, ko‘p sayyohlar keldi.
Soyabon oling. Tushdan keyin yomg‘ir yog‘ishi mumkin.
So‘nggi natijalar ikki tilli bolalar bir vazifadan boshqasiga osonroq o‘tishiga ishora qiladi.
So‘nggi o‘n yil ichida internetdan foydalanish bir maromda o‘sib keldi.
So‘rovnoma: 30 talabadan 16 tasi avtobusda, 8 tasi piyoda, 4 tasi taksida, 2 tasi velosipedda keladi. 3–4 gap bilan tasvirlang: kasr so‘zi, taxminlovchi so‘z va the number / proportion of.
So‘rovnomadagi kattalarning taxminan beshdan biri hech qachon samolyotda uchmagan.
So‘z boyligi va grammatika, keyin SAT savollari.
So‘z ma’nosini so‘rash: What does this word mean?
So‘z mos kelishi — tuzoq bo‘lishi mumkin.
So‘z o‘yinlari — Words in Context savollari uchun.
So‘z s, ss, sh, ch, x bilan tugasa -es qo‘shiladi: bus → buses, class → classes, watch → watches, box → boxes. Undoshdan keyin -y bo‘lsa -ies: city → cities, baby → babies (lekin day → days).
So‘z sonidan kam yozsangiz — ball tushadi. Juda ko‘p yozish ham foyda bermaydi: 170–190 (Task 1) va 260–290 (Task 2) so‘z — yaxshi oraliq. Shaxsiy hikoya emas, rasmiy uslub.

So‘z tartibi muhim: tasdiq gapda ravish will dan KEYIN keladi — will probably, will definitely. Inkorda esa won’t dan OLDIN — probably won’t, definitely won’t. “He won’t probably come” — xato; to‘g‘risi: He probably won’t come.

So‘z turkumini gapdagi o‘rni ko‘rsatadi: artikl yoki sifatdan keyin — ot (“the development of”), ot oldida yoki be dan keyin — sifat (“an effective method”, “it is effective”), fe’ldan keyin — ravish (“work effectively”). O‘zbek o‘quvchilarning odatiy xatosi — o‘zakni to‘g‘ri tanlab, turkumni adashtirish: “It has a big effective on health” (to‘g‘risi effect), economic va economical ni chalkashtirish (economic — iqtisodiy, economical — tejamkor).
So‘zlar chegarasini tekshiring: kam bo‘lsa ball ketadi, ko‘p bo‘lsa vaqt.
So‘zlar soni {0} ta, minimum {1} ta. Kam so‘z ball kamayishiga olib keladi.
So‘zlar takrorlanyapti. Sinonimlar va aniqroq so‘zlar ishlating.

So‘zli masala: o‘zgaruvchini aniq ta’riflang (t = xabarlar soni), tenglama tuzing (12 + 0,05t = 15,50), yeching va javobni savolga moslang (butun son bo‘lishi kerakmi?). Tez usul: javob variantlarini tenglamaga qo‘yib tekshirish (backsolving) — SAT da ruxsat etilgan va vaqt tejaydi. Doim oxirgi javobni asl tenglamaga qo‘yib tekshiring.

So‘zli masalada ikkita noma’lum → ikkita tenglama: “Kattalar chiptasi $8, bolalarniki $5. 30 chipta $198 ga sotildi.” → a + c = 30; 8a + 5c = 198. Savolga qarang: kattalar sonimi, jami daromadmi? Tekshirish: juftlikni ikkala tenglamaga qo‘ying.

So‘zli masalada m — “har bir … uchun o‘zgarish” (rate), b — boshlang‘ich qiymat. “Hisob 500 dollardan boshlanib, haftasiga 20 dollarga kamayadi” → y = 500 − 20x: qiyalik −20, kesishma 500. “What does 20 represent?” — haftalik kamayish. Birliklarga e’tibor bering: qiyalik birligi = y birligi / x birligi.

So‘zli masalalar: “at least” (kamida) → ≥; “at most”, “no more than” (ko‘pi bilan) → ≤; “more than” → >; “fewer than” → <. 50 dollar bor, kitob 8 dollar: 8n ≤ 50 → n ≤ 6,25 → ko‘pi bilan 6 ta kitob (butun son talab qilinsa pastga yaxlitlanadi; “kamida” savolida yuqoriga).
So‘zni MATNDAN aynan ko‘chiring — o‘zgartirmang (sinonim yozmang). Imlo xatosi bo‘lsa, ball yo‘q.

So‘zni bilmasangiz — tushuntiring (paraphrase): “It’s a kind of tool you use for…”, “I don’t remember the exact word, but it’s something like…”, “the person who…”. Imtihonchi uchun bu ravonlik belgisi.
So‘zni bilmasangiz, tushuntirib bering. Urinish ham baholanadi.
So‘zni matnda qanday bo‘lsa, aynan shunday ko‘chiring.
Speaking Part 2: g‘oya tugasa, o‘sha paytdagi hissingizni tasvirlang.

Speaking — imtihonchi bilan yuzma-yuz suhbat, 11–14 daqiqa. 1-qism (4–5 daqiqa): o‘zingiz, uy, ish, o‘qish, qiziqishlar haqida qisqa savollar. 2-qism (3–4 daqiqa): kartochkadagi mavzu, 1 daqiqa tayyorgarlik, 1–2 daqiqa to‘xtovsiz gapirish. 3-qism (4–5 daqiqa): 2-qism mavzusi bo‘yicha chuqurroq, umumiy savollar.
Sport va mashg‘ulotlar uchun to‘g‘ri fe’lni tanlaysiz: play football, go swimming, do yoga.
Standart ingliz qoidalari (gap tuzilishi, moslashuv, tinish belgilari)

Standart og‘ish (standard deviation, SD) — qiymatlar o‘rtachadan qanchalik uzoqligi. SAT da hisoblash emas, taqqoslash so‘raladi: qiymatlar o‘rtacha atrofida zich bo‘lsa SD kichik, keng tarqalgan bo‘lsa katta. Hamma qiymatga son qo‘shilsa mean o‘zgaradi, SD o‘zgarmaydi; k ga ko‘paytirilsa mean va SD ikkalasi ham k marta o‘zgaradi.
Statistika: markaz, tarqoqlik va nuqtali grafiklar

Suffikslar so‘z turkumini o‘zgartiradi: -ise / -ize (fe’l): modernise, prioritise; -ity / -ness / -ance (ot): flexibility, awareness, reliance; -ive / -ous (sifat): innovative, ambiguous; -wise (… jihatdan, norasmiy): Money-wise, it’s a good deal.

Suhbat tartibi: (1) tanishuv — “Hi, I’m Aziz. Nice to meet you.” — “Nice to meet you too.” (2) “Where are you from?” (3) “What do you do?” — “I’m a student. And you?” (4) qiziqish — “What do you do in your free time?” (5) xayrlashish — “It was nice talking to you. See you soon!”
Suhbat uslubini emas, rasmiy uslubni ishlating.
Suhbat vaqti tugadi — yangi suhbatni boshlashingiz mumkin.
Suhbatda yoki intervyuda hayotingizda nimalar qilganingiz, qayerlarda bo‘lganingiz va yaqinda nima o‘zgargani haqida gapirish.

Suhbatdosh “I like football” desa, rozi bo‘lish: “Me too.” yoki “So do I.” (men ham). Inkor gapga: “I don’t like fish.” — “Me neither.” yoki “Neither do I.” (men ham yoqtirmayman). Rozi bo‘lmasangiz: “Really? I do.” / “I don’t.”
Suhbatdoshning fikriga I agree (with…), You’re right, I see what you mean, but… kabi iboralar bilan muloyim qo‘shilasiz yoki e’tiroz bildirasiz.
Sumkangizdagi yoki xonangizdagi 3 ta narsani rangi bilan yozing (a / an ni unutmang).
Summa: nolga teng bo‘lmagan butun son (kichik birlikda)
Suppose / supposing + Past Simple: faraz. Suppose you won the lottery, what would you do?
Suv — shishada: a bottle of water.
TRUE — gap matndagi ma’lumot bilan bir xil (paraphrase bo‘lishi mumkin). FALSE — gap matndagi ma’lumotga ZID, ya’ni matn teskarisini aytadi.
Tabiat haqidagi hujjatli film ovozi: marjon riflarining ahamiyati va tahdidlari.
Tabiat so‘zlarini bilasiz va mamlakatingiz tabiatini there is / there are bilan tasvirlaysiz; daryo va dengiz nomlari oldida the ishlatasiz.

Tabiat: mountain (tog‘), river (daryo), lake (ko‘l), sea (dengiz), forest (o‘rmon), desert (cho‘l), field (dala), island (orol), sky (osmon), sun (quyosh), tree (daraxt), flower (gul). “Uzbekistan has mountains, rivers and deserts.”
Tabiiy ovozli audio, forma va test savollari
Tabrik kartochkasi va taklifnoma yozasiz (Dear…, Happy birthday!, Can you come?) va taklifga javob berasiz.

Tabrik kartochkasi: (1) murojaat — “Dear Aziz,” (2) tabrik — “Happy birthday!” (3) tilak — “I hope you have a great day.” (4) xayrlashish — “Best wishes, Dilnoza”. Gaplar qisqa va samimiy bo‘ladi. Murojaatdan keyin vergul qo‘yiladi.

Tabrik va minnatdorchilik: “Happy birthday!” “Congratulations!” “Happy New Year!” “Thank you very much!” — “You’re welcome.” “This is for you.” — “Oh, thank you! It’s lovely.” Xayrlashishda: “Have a nice day!”
Tabriklaymiz! Sizga Sellzen yutuq sertifikati berildi.
Tadqiqot ijtimoiy tarmoqlar uyquga qay darajada ta’sir qilishini o‘rganadi.
Tadqiqot natijalarini taqqoslash va jarayonlarni aniq tushuntirish.

Tadqiqot natijasi haqida qisqa akademik paragraf yozing (mavzu: maktab o‘quvchilarining uyqusi). Kamida 3 ta akademik phrasal verb (carry out, account for, rule out, bring about, point out) ishlating va norasmiylaridan qoching.
Tadqiqot yoki manbani baholab, uning kuchli va zaif tomonlarini sample, bias, flawed, inconclusive, fail to take into account kabi akademik iboralar bilan asoslab yozasiz.
Tadqiqotni shakar ishlab chiqaruvchi kompaniya moliyalashtirgani uchun unda tarafkashlik bo‘lishi mumkin.
Tagda gapdagi yordamchi fe’l takrorlanadi: be → is/are/was; can → can; have (present perfect) → have. Yordamchi bo‘lmasa — do/does/did: “She lives here, doesn’t she?” “You called him, didn’t you?”
Tajriba: uxlagan talabalar ko‘proq eslab qolgan
Taklif bonusi: ikkala tomonga All Access kunlari
Taklif qildi, rad etdi: reporting verbs
Taklif qilgan bir kishiga 30 kunda ko‘pi bilan bonus
Taklif qilingan o‘quvchi birinchi dars yoki daraja testini tugatganda ikkala tomonga beriladi.
Taklif qilinganda savol gapda ham 'some' ishlatiladi.
Taklif qilish: Would you like to…? Let’s…
Taklif qilish: “Would you like to come to my birthday party?” (to + fe’l). Do‘stona: “Let’s go to the cinema!” (Let’s + fe’l, to siz). “Why don’t we have a picnic?”
Taklifga rozilik — Yes, I’d love to!

Taklifnoma: “Please come to my birthday party! Date: Saturday, 5th May. Time: 6 p.m. Place: my house, 12 Navoi Street.” Savol: “Can you come?” Javob: “Yes, I’d love to!” yoki “Sorry, I can’t. I’m busy.”
Taklifnomada sana, vaqt va joy bo‘ladi.

Takror (redundancy) — bir ma’noni ikki marta aytish: future plans (reja doim kelajak haqida), past history, end result, return back, completely unanimous. O‘zbekchada “eng optimal” deyish ortiqcha bo‘lgani kabi, inglizchada “return back” ham ortiqcha: return yetarli.
Takror: past history, each and every, close proximity. Future plans va clear explanation — takror emas.
Takrorlanadigan qismni qisqartiring: “I live in Tashkent. I work in Tashkent.” → “I live and work in Tashkent.” Ikki sifatni ham and bilan bog‘lash mumkin: “The flat is small and quiet.”
Takrorlanadigan so‘zlarni tabiiy tushirib qoldirasiz: yordamchi fe’l yoki to bilan javob berasiz.

Takrorlanish: every day (har kuni), twice a week (haftada ikki marta), at the weekend (dam olish kunlari). “Listen” dan keyin to qo‘yiladi: listen to music. “Mean” bilan does: What does “bag” mean? (means emas).
Takrorni kamaytiring: “pollution” 6 marta emas — air quality, emissions, environmental damage. Lekin noto‘g‘ri sinonimdan ko‘ra bir xil so‘z yaxshiroq — notanish “kitob so‘z”larni tavakkal qilmang.
Talabalar munozarasida rozilik va e’tirozni ajratib, qaysi fikr kimga tegishliligini va yakuniy qarorni aniqlaysiz.
Talabalar va o‘qituvchi guruh taqdimotini rejalashtirmoqda (B2 daraja, IELTS Part 3 uslubida).
Talaffuz: -s uch xil o‘qiladi: /s/ — works, stops; /z/ — plays, lives, goes; /ɪz/ — watches, washes, fixes (alohida bo‘g‘in beradi). “She watches TV” da watches ikki bo‘g‘inli o‘qiladi.

Tana a’zolari: head (bosh), face (yuz), eye (ko‘z), ear (quloq), nose (burun), mouth (og‘iz), tooth (tish), neck (bo‘yin), arm (qo‘l, yelkadan bilakkacha), hand (kaft, qo‘l), finger (barmoq), leg (oyoq, sondan to‘pig‘igacha), foot (tovon va panja), back (orqa), stomach (qorin).
Tana a’zolarini aytish, shifokorga kasallikni tushuntirish, o‘zini qanday his qilishingizni va sog‘lom odatlaringizni aytish.
Tana a’zolarining nomlarini bilasiz (head, hand, leg…), noto‘g‘ri ko‘plikni (teeth, feet) ishlatasiz va tashqi ko‘rinishni have / has bilan aytasiz.
Tanish mavzularda fikr bildirasiz. IELTS formatiga tayyorgarlikni boshlash vaqti.
Tanishtirgandan keyin ma’lumot berish uchun he’s, she’s, they’re ishlatiladi: he’s = he is, she’s = she is, they’re = they are. “She’s a nurse. He’s twenty. They’re from Bukhara.”
Tanishtirish: This is… / These are… / He’s, She’s, They’re
Tanishtirish: atama + qisqa ta’rif + asosiy xususiyat.
Tanishtirish: ot + qisqa ta’rif (a New Zealand parrot) + asosiy xususiyat. Boshqalar qaydlarga zid yoki ortiqcha.
Tanlagan vaqtingiz bilan maqsadga yetish real ko‘rinadi (taxminan {0} soat o‘qish imkoni bor, kerak — ~{1} soat).
Tanlangan davrda ro‘yxatdan o‘tgan o‘quvchilar. Har bir qadam — shu o‘quvchilardan nechtasi (noyob) ro‘yxatdan keyin istalgan vaqtda bajargan.
Tanlanma kichik bo‘lsa-da, natijalar e’tiborga loyiq.

Tanlanma va xulosa: tasodifiy (random) tanlanma butun populyatsiyaga umumlashtirishga imkon beradi; ixtiyoriy (voluntary) so‘rov — yo‘q (tanlov xatosi). Xato chegarasi (margin of error): 52% ± 4% → populyatsiyada 48% dan 56% gacha. Tanlanma qancha katta bo‘lsa, xato chegarasi shuncha kichik. Sabab-oqibat xulosasi faqat tasodifiy taqsimlangan guruhlari bor eksperimentdan (random assignment) chiqariladi.
Tanlov savolida kamida: savol | 2 ta variant | izoh
Taqiq: Don’t + fe’l: “Don’t run!” “Don’t be late.” please qo‘shilsa — muloyimroq.
Taqqoslang: a lot of — oddiy “ko‘p” (yaxshi yoki yomon emas), too much — ortiqcha, yoqmaydi: “This tea has too much sugar.”
Taqqoslash tuzilmalari: higher/lower than; twice/three times as many … as; the highest/lowest proportion of; X, whereas Y; by contrast; similarly; just over / just under (taxminan).
Taqqoslash, jarayon va xarita, bog‘lanish, akademik so‘z boyligi va xulosa — 6.5+ uchun yozma ish sifati.
Taqqoslashni aniq darajada kuchaytirasiz yoki yumshatasiz: far / considerably / marginally, nowhere near as, every bit as, not nearly as.
Tariflar sahifasidagi raqamlar shu qiymatlardan avtomatik yangilanadi.

Tartib sonlar: 1st — first, 2nd — second, 3rd — third, 4th — fourth, 5th — fifth, 12th — twelfth, 20th — twentieth, 21st — twenty-first. “My flat is on the fifth floor.” Sana: “on the 5th of May”. Tartib son oldidan the qo‘yiladi: the third floor.
Tartib sonlari (first, second, third…) bilan sanani aytasiz va qachon tug‘ilganingizni yozasiz.
Tartib: ega + fe'l + joy + usul + vaqt.
Tartib: ot + which + qo‘shimcha ma’lumot + asosiy fe’l. (Yozuvda vergullar bilan: Bukhara, which is very old, is beautiful.)
Tartibi qat’iy bo‘lgan juft iboralarni (binomials) to‘g‘ri tartibda va o‘rinli ishlatasiz.
Tartibni almashtirsangiz, g‘alati eshitiladi: “later or sooner”, “cons and pros” — xato. Ular o‘zbekchadagi “oldi-berdi”, “u-bu” kabi.
Tashkent so‘zi katta harf bilan boshlanadi.
Tashrif — kun va qurilma bo‘yicha taxminan noyob.
Task 1 da shaxsiy fikr bildirilmaydi, faqat ma‘lumotni tasvirlang.
Task 1 tuzilishi: 1) Kirish — savolni paraphrase qiling (The chart shows → The bar chart illustrates…). 2) Overview — umumiy xulosa. 3–4) Ikki abzats tafsilot (sonlar bilan).
Task 1 uchun kirish (nima tasvirlangan), umumiy tendensiya (overview) va tafsilotlar abzatslarini ajrating.
Task 1 va Task 2 nimani talab qiladi, overview, trend so‘zlari, kirish va abzats tuzilishi — yozma ishning skeleti.
Task 1 va Task 2, taymer, tekshiruv va AI baho
Task 2 (40 daqiqa): 5 daqiqa — savolni tahlil va reja (pozitsiya, 2 asosiy fikr, har biriga misol); 30 daqiqa — yozish; 5 daqiqa — tekshirish. Rejasiz yozilgan esse ko‘pincha mavzudan chetga chiqadi.
Task 2 Task 1 dan ikki baravar ko‘p ball beradi.

Task 2 abzasi: “Katta shaharlarda tirbandlik muammosini qanday hal qilish mumkin?” 4–5 gap: muammoni (pose a threat / put pressure on) va kamida ikki yechimni (tackle / address, take measures, raise awareness, meet demand…) birikmalar bilan yozing.

Task 2 abzasi: “Onlayn ta’lim an’anaviy darsdan samaraliroqmi?” 4–5 gap. Dalilni kamida ikki xil kuchdagi fe’l bilan yetkazing (demonstrate / show va suggest / indicate) hamda bog‘liqlik qolipini ishlating (linked to / associated with / correlation).
Task 2 abzasida qarshi fikrni adolatli taqdim etib (It could be argued that…), qisman tan olasiz (Admittedly…) va unga dalil bilan raddiya berasiz (However, this overlooks…).
Task 2 da dunyodan misol kerak, shaxsiy voqea emas.
Task 2 da kamida 250 so‘z kerak; juda uzun insho vaqtingizni oladi va xatoni oshiradi.
Task 2 ga taxminan qirq daqiqa sarflang.
Task 2 insho: yozing va “AI baholash”ni bosing — 4 mezon bo‘yicha band chiqadi

Task 2 mavzulari (ekologiya, ta’lim, sog‘liq, shahar hayoti) bir xil “muammo — sabab — yechim” tilini talab qiladi. Oddiy make, do, give o‘rniga aniq fe’l + ot birikmalarini ishlating. Muammo: pose a threat / risk to, have a detrimental effect on, put pressure on. Yechim: tackle / address / deal with a problem, take measures / steps to, raise awareness of, meet the demand for, bridge the gap between.
Task 2 ni 5 daqiqada rejalashtirasiz, yangi fikrsiz xulosa yozasiz va oxirgi 3 daqiqada tekshiruv ro‘yxatidan foydalanasiz.

Task 2 savol turlari: 1) Opinion — “To what extent do you agree?” (fikringiz). 2) Discussion — “Discuss both views and give your opinion” (ikki tomon + fikringiz). 3) Advantages/Disadvantages. 4) Problem/Solution — “What are the causes and solutions?”. 5) Two-part question — ikki alohida savol.
Task 2 savolining turini (opinion, discuss, advantages, problem/solution) aniqlab, kirishda aniq pozitsiya (thesis) yozasiz.
Task 2 uchun odatda 4–5 ta abzats kerak: kirish, 2 ta asosiy abzats, xulosa.
Task 2: savol turlari va asosiy fikr
Task 2: “Maktab formasi bekor qilinishi kerakmi?” Formani qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi abzas yozing: qarshi fikrni taqdim eting, uni qisman tan oling va dalil bilan rad eting.
Tasodifiy taqsimlangan nazorat guruhi bor eksperiment.
Taxminan 40 daqiqa va har 5 daqiqada hisobot

Taxminlash: just over / slightly more than (biroz ko‘p), just under / nearly / almost (biroz kam), approximately / roughly / around (taxminan). Ko‘paytma: twice as many … as, three times as much … as. O‘zbekcha “ikki barobar ko‘p” ni so‘zma-so‘z “two times more” deb yozish keng tarqalgan; akademik yozuvda twice as many / much as yoki double aniqroq va xavfsizroq.

Tayyor javoblar: “Sure!” (albatta), “OK.”, “No problem.”, “Sorry, I can’t.”, “Thanks!”, “Where are you?”, “What time?” Qisqartmalar: pls = please, thx = thanks, u = you, asap = as soon as possible. Rasmiy xatda qisqartma ishlatilmaydi.
Tayyor savol: What’s the weather like?
Ta’kid: do / does / did, so va such
Ta’kidlovchi do / does / did + asosiy fe’l: I do understand your concern. She did call you — check your phone.
Ta’kidlovchi gaplar: It is … that …, What … is …
Ta’limga sarmoya kiritish uzoq muddatli ijtimoiy o‘zgarishlarni yuzaga keltirishi mumkin.
Tekshiruv ro‘yxati: savolning hamma qismiga javob berdimmi? Pozitsiya kirish va xulosada bir xilmi? Fe’l zamonlari, ko‘plik -s, artikllar, so‘z soni (250+).
Telefon orqali tort buyurtma qilish (A2 daraja, IELTS Part 1 uslubida).
Telefon qilish, hamkasb va notanish odamlarga muloyim iltimos qilish hamda do‘stlarga his-tuyg‘ularingiz haqida xabar yozish.
Telefon va internetdan nima uchun foydalanishingizni 4–5 gap bilan yozing (I use … to…).
Telefon, kompyuter va internetdan foydalanish haqida gapirish, qisqa xabarlar yozish va onlayn xarid.
Telefonda o‘zingizni tanishtirasiz, kerakli odamni so‘raysiz, xabar qoldirasiz va qayta qo‘ng‘iroq qilishni kelishasiz.

Telefonda o‘zingizni tanishtirganda inglizlar “I am Aziz” emas, “This is Aziz” yoki “It’s Aziz” deyishadi. Odamni so‘rash: Can I speak to Madina, please? / Is Madina there? Agar so‘ralgan odam siz bo‘lsangiz: Speaking. (= Men eshitaman.) Kuttirish: Just a moment, please. / Hold on, please.
Telefonda: This is…, Can I speak to…?
Telefondan nima uchun foydalanasiz? Musiqa tinglash uchun.
Telefonimda aloqa yo‘q edi, shuning uchun senga qo‘ng‘iroq qila olmadim.
Telefonni o‘chiring, naushnik taqing va to‘xtamasdan bajaring.
Telegram orqali, bir bosishda. Progress, reyting va obuna boshqa qurilmada ham ochiladi.
Telegram tugmasi chiqmadi? Pastdagi boshqa usul bilan kiring.
Telegram tugmasi faqat bu manzilda ishlaydi:
Telegram webhook o‘rnatilmadi (oldingi webhook amal qilishda davom etishi mumkin):
Telegram webhook: {0} — {1} s dan keyin qayta urinish ({2}/{3})
Telegram, Google yoki telefon raqam bilan. Mock testlar bepul.
Teng kuchli ifodalar: qavs ochish, ko‘paytuvchilarga ajratish, darajalar

Tenglama 2ˣ = 32 kabi bo‘lsa, asoslarni tenglang: 2ˣ = 2⁵ → x = 5. (1/2)ˣ = 8 → 2⁻ˣ = 2³ → x = −3. Javoblarni tekshirishda variantni funksiyaga qo‘yib ko‘ring. Izoh savolida “a” — boshlang‘ich qiymat, “b − 1” — davr uchun o‘zgarish foizi ekanini yodda tuting.
Tenglik: as + sifat + as: This phone is as good as that one. Inkor: not as … as = …dan kamroq: The bus is not as fast as the train.
Tengsizlikni yechasiz (manfiyga ko‘paytirganda belgi o‘zgarishini unutmaysiz), so‘zli masalalarda at least / at most ni to‘g‘ri belgilaysiz va butun son javobini topasiz.
Teskari xulosa uchun can’t (mustn’t emas!): “He can’t be hungry — he has just eaten.” mustn’t — taqiq ma’nosida (B1 3-bo‘lim), xulosa uchun emas.

Vergul qoidasi №1: ortiqcha (nonessential) ma’lumot — olib tashlasangiz ham gap ma’nosi buzilmaydigan qism — ikki tomondan BIR XIL belgi bilan ajratiladi: ikkita vergul, ikkita tire yoki qavs. “My sister, who lives in Samarkand, is a nurse.” Bir tomonda vergul, ikkinchisida tire (“, … —”) — xato.

Vergul yana kerak: (1) ro‘yxat elementlari orasida; (2) kirish qismdan keyin (“After the storm, the road reopened.”); (3) ikki mustaqil gap orasida vergul + FANBOYS. Xato — aralashtirish: rasmiy xatda “Hey, I wanna find out…” yoki do‘stga “I wish to ascertain…”. C2 — vaziyatga mos uslubni tanlay olish.
Xato! Yana shunday qilsang, daftarga yozib qo‘yaman.
Xato: whereas (farq), faqat farqlarni sanash, qaydlardan tashqari fakt.
Xato: “I live here since 2020” — o‘zbek tiliga o‘xshatib Present Simple ishlatiladi. To‘g‘risi: “I have lived here since 2020.”
Xato: “If I would have known” — if qismida would ishlatilmaydi: If I had known.
Xato: “The house was build” — 3-shakl kerak: was built. “It was happened” — happen o‘timsiz fe’l, passivi yo‘q: It happened.
Xato: “What I need it is a holiday” — ortiqcha it. “It was in 2010 when we met” o‘rniga rasmiyroq: It was in 2010 that we met.
Xato: “more cheaper”, “more better” — ikki marta taqqoslash bo‘lmaydi.
Xatolar «Xatolarim» bo‘limiga tushdi. Qoidani yana bir ko‘rib, qayta jang qiling.

Xatolar: (1) “For example” faqat oldingi umumiy fikrga aniq misol kelganda; (2) “Therefore” faqat haqiqiy sabab-natijada — ikkinchi gap shunchaki yana bir fakt bo‘lsa, in addition; (3) “However” faqat ikkinchi gap birinchisiga ZID bo‘lsa. Har bir ikkinchi gapni birinchisidan keyin kelgan fikr sifatida tekshiring: “bu uni davom ettiryaptimi yoki unga qarshi chiqyaptimi?”
Xatolar: “More you practise, better you become” (the tushib qolgan) yoki “The more you practise, you become better” (ikkinchi qism ham the bilan boshlanishi kerak).
Xatolaringiz asosida shaxsiy o‘quv rejasini olasiz
Xatolaringiz shu yerda 1, 3, 7 kundan keyin qaytadi.
Xatolaringiz — sizning dasturingiz. Har hafta ularni takrorlang.
Xavf “hal qilinmaydi”: pose / reduce / eliminate a threat.
Xavf: ma’noni o‘zgartirib qo‘yish (always → often), rasmiylikni buzish yoki faqat sinonim bilan “ko‘chirish”. Yaxshi paraphrase’da kamida ikki vosita birga ishlaydi.
Xayoliy holatlar, o‘tmishdagi tanlovlar haqida gapirish va qarama-qarshi fikrlarni bog‘lab, asosli fikr bildirish (IELTS Speaking va Writing uchun ham kerak).
Xayoliy istak uchun 'I'd love to have' ishlating.
Xizmatlardan foydalanish (soch oldirish, mashina tuzattirish), o‘tmishdagi voqealar haqida mantiqiy taxmin va kelajak rejalarini aniq ifodalash.
Xodim avval saytda hisob ochadi, so‘ng rolni tanlab, laqabini yozing. Metodist — darslar, hamkor — referal, o‘qituvchi — guruhlar, operator — lidlar.
Xodim yuborildi / tinchroq xona taklif qilindi
Xona bron qilasiz va olasiz (I have a reservation), narx va nonushta haqida so‘raysiz va oddiy muammolarni aytasiz.
Xona yigirma kishiga yetarlicha katta edi.

Xonada nima borligini aytish uchun There is (bitta narsa) va There are (bir nechta narsa) ishlatiladi: “There is a sofa in the living room.” “There are two chairs in the kitchen.” There is ning qisqartmasi there’s; There are ning qisqartmasi yo‘q.
Xonalar va mebel nomlarini aytasiz, xonada nima borligini there is / there are bilan aytasiz va Is there…? deb so‘raysiz.
Xonalar va mebel: there is, there are
Xonangizda nimalar borligini yozing (There is / There are dan foydalaning).
Xonangizdagi 3–4 ta narsa qayerda turganini yozing (on, in, under, next to kabi predloglardan foydalaning).
Xonangizdagi narsalarni ko‘rsatib 3 ta gap yozing: this, these, that yoki those bilan.
Xonangizni tasvirlang: narsalar qayerda joylashgan (3 ta gap).
Xorijda adashib qoldingiz. Yo‘lovchiga 4 ta gap yozing: yordam so‘rang, qayerga borishni ayting va sekinroq gapirishni so‘rang.
Xotiralar, tajribalar va ayblovlar haqida aniq gapirish: ma’no tuzilmaga qarab o‘zgarganda.
Xo‘sh, o‘ylab ko‘ray… Menimcha, asosiy sabab — pul.
Xuddi shu format, kamida 5 ta savol.
Xullas, avtobus kutib turibman, bir kampir men bilan gaplasha boshlaydi.
Xullas, aytganimdek, yig‘ilish soat o‘nda boshlanadi.
Xulosa chiqarish: parchadan nima mantiqan kelib chiqadi
Xulosa qilib aytganda, afzalliklar kamchiliklardan ustun deb qat’iy ishonaman.
Xulosa qilib aytganda, bu tur hozir himoyada.
Xulosa: All things considered, … (hamma narsani hisobga olsak); On balance, … Bu iboralar odatda gap boshida turadi va vergul oladi. IELTS speaking va writing’da ball oshiradi.
Xulosa: “In conclusion, …” bilan pozitsiyani qayta ayting va asosiy fikrlarni qisqacha umumlashtiring. YANGI fikr yoki misol qo‘shmang. 2–3 gap yetarli.
Xulosalar shubhali, chunki tanlanma umumiy aholini aks ettirmagan.

Xush kelibsiz! Ingliz alifbosida 26 ta harf bor va ularning ko‘pi sizga lotin yozuvidan tanish. Faqat harflarning NOMI boshqacha aytiladi: A — “ey”, E — “i:”, I — “ay”, Y — “uay”, R — “a:”, W — “dabl yu”, Z — “zed”.
Xususiy maktablar soni 2015-yildan beri deyarli ikki baravar oshdi.
Yagona va noyob narsalar (sun, moon, sky) oldidan 'the' qo'yiladi.
Yana bir fakt qo‘shilmoqda: In addition.
Yana bir usul: “Can I have a sandwich, please?” Ofitsiant so‘raydi: “Would you like anything else?” — Javob: “Yes, please.” / “No, thank you.”

Yana ikkitasi: get the ball rolling (ishni boshlab yubormoq) va be on the same page (bir xil fikrda, bir xil tushunchada bo‘lmoq). Shakli qat’iy: “the ball is in your court” (on your side emas), “up in the air” (“on the air” — bu “efirda” degani!), “back to the drawing board” (birlikda, the bilan).

Yana: odds and ends (mayda-chuyda), peace and quiet (tinchlik-osoyishtalik), safe and sound (sog‘-salomat), ups and downs (past-balandlik), first and foremost (avvalambor), little by little (asta-sekin).
Yangi avtobus yo‘nalishi haqida e’lon (A2 daraja, IELTS Part 2 uslubida).
Yangi chet ellik do‘stingizga qisqa xat yozing: ismingiz, qayerdansiz, nima qilasiz, nimani yaxshi ko‘rasiz. and, but va because ni ishlating.
Yangi dalillar dastlabki nazariyani rad etdi.
Yangi do‘stingiz haqida 5 ta savol yozing (Where…? What…? When…? Why…? Which…?).
Yangi gap boshida natija — That’s why.
Yangi gap boshida, vergul bilan: However.
Yangi hamkasbingiz bilan suhbat boshlang: 4 ta gap, har birining oxirida question tag.
Yangi hamkasbingizga 3 ta muloyim iltimos yozing: ikkitasi Could you…?, bittasi Could I…? bilan.
Yangi joyga (ish, shahar, universitet) ko‘chganingizni tasavvur qiling: nimaga ko‘nikkansiz, nimaga ko‘nikyapsiz, ilgari nima qilardingiz.
Yangi kvartiraga ko‘chish kunini yozing: kamida 4 ta iboraviy fe’l, kamida bittasi olmosh bilan o‘rtada (put it down, turn it on).
Yangi metro liniyasi o‘tgan yili ochildi.
Yangi odam bilan 6–8 qatorli suhbat o‘tkazasiz: tanishuv, qayerdan, nima ish qiladi, qiziqish, xayrlashish.
Yangi odam bilan tanishish: o‘zingizni tanishtirish, ism, yosh, kasb va qayerdanligingizni aytish.
Yangi qonun yoshlar ishsizligining asl sabablariga qarshi kurashishni maqsad qilgan.
Yangi shaharda kundalik hayot: ishga qanday borasiz, do‘konda o‘lcham va narx so‘raysiz, yangi do‘stga o‘zingiz haqida xat yozasiz.
Yangi shaharga ko‘chish: nimaga ko‘nikish qiyin bo‘ldi, bolalikda nimalar qilardik, kim sizni nima bilan asabiylashtiradi.
Yangi sinfdoshingizga 3 ta savol yozing (what, where, how old … dan foydalaning).
Yangi talabalarga maslahatlar (B2 daraja, IELTS Part 2 uslubida).
Yangi tanishingiz bilan qisqa suhbat yozing (A: va B:): tanishuv, qayerdan, nima ish qiladi, xayrlashish.
Yangi tanishingizga 2 ta savol yozing (Are you…? / Is your…?) va o‘zingiz haqida 1 ta inkor gap.
Yangi tanishingizga 5 ta ha-yo‘q savoli yozing (Do you…? Does your… ?) va ularning qisqa javoblarini ko‘rsating.
Yangi tanishingizga predlog bilan tugaydigan 3 ta savol yozing (from, about, to, for).
Yangi telefon eskisidan juda oz farq bilan yaxshiroq.
Yangi zavod hududga ish o‘rinlari olib keladi.
Yangilik maqolasi uslubida qisqa xabar yozing: It is reported / believed that … va … is said / thought to have + V3 tuzilmalarini ishlating.
Yangilik, hisobot va boshqalarning gapini yetkazish: kim nima qilgani muhim bo‘lmaganda, kim nima deganini aytishda, narsalarni aniq tasvirlashda.
Yangiliklar va ilmiy matnlarda ma’lumotni masofa saqlab berish (It is said that…), fikrni kuchaytirish va so‘z tartibi bilan ta’kid.
Yaponiyada bo‘lganmisiz? — Yo‘q, lekin juda borgim keladi.
Yaponiyada keksalar ulushi eng yuqori, Hindistonda esa eng past edi.
Yaqin va uzoqdagi bitta yoki ko‘p narsani this / that / these / those bilan to‘g‘ri ko‘rsatasiz.
Yaqinda ko‘rgan film, kitob yoki tadbir haqida his-tuyg‘ularingizni kuchli ta’kid bilan yozing: ta’kidlovchi do/did, so … that va such … that ni ishlating.
Yaqinda tugagan, natijasi ko‘rinib turgan harakat uchun ham: “Why are you wet? — I’ve been running in the rain.”
Yaqindagi bitta narsa — this, ko‘p narsa — these. Uzoqdagi bitta narsa — that, ko‘p narsa — those.
Yaxshi fikr, lekin buning pulini kim to‘laydi?
Yaxshi hikoya tinglovchini adashtirmaydi. Buning uchun ketma-ketlik so‘zlari ishlatiladi: First (avval), Then (keyin), After that (shundan so‘ng), Later (keyinroq), Finally / In the end (oxirida).
Yaxshi hikoyada uchta zamon o‘z vazifasini bajaradi: past continuous — sahna va fon (It was raining, people were hurrying home).

Yaxshi matnda bir so‘z qayta-qayta takrorlanmaydi. Ikki narsadan keyin: the former (birinchisi), the latter (ikkinchisi): “Cars and bicycles both have advantages; the latter, however, are far greener.”
Yaxshi qurdingiz, lekin jim qolganda qavatlar quladi. “Well…”, “Let me think…” bilan vaqt yuting.
Yaxshi tezlik va xilma-xillik. Endi grammatika va talaffuzni Sellzen bilan sinash vaqti.

Yaxshiroq usul — referencing: oldingi fikrga olmosh yoki ot bilan qaytish. “Governments should tax sugary drinks. THIS MEASURE would reduce obesity.” Shuningdek: this, these, such, the former / the latter, it, they.

Yechimlar soni: qiyaliklar turlicha → aynan bitta yechim (chiziqlar kesishadi); qiyalik teng, kesishma turlicha → yechim yo‘q (parallel chiziqlar); ikki tenglama bir xil chiziq → cheksiz ko‘p yechim. “For what value of k does the system have no solution?” — x va y koeffitsientlari mutanosib bo‘lsin, erkin had mutanosib bo‘lmasin.
Yer ho‘l. Tun bo‘yi yomg‘ir yog‘ib turgan bo‘lsa kerak.
Yes / No / Not Given: muallif fikri
Yetarli pul yig‘ib, ular kvartira sotib olishdi.
Yetkazib berish ikki kun oladi. U juma kuni keladi.
Yeydigan hech narsa yo‘q edi, shuning uchun kafega bordik.
Yig‘ilish cho‘zilishi mumkin, bunday holda sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman.
Yig‘ilish ko‘rinishdan xavfsizlik haqida edi, aslida esa budjet qisqartirish haqida.
Yig‘ilishda o‘ttiz chog‘li odam bor edi.
Yil oxirigacha yigirmata kitob o‘qib bo‘lgan bo‘laman.
Yillar ikkita juftlikda o‘qiladi: 1991 — nineteen ninety-one; 1998 — nineteen ninety-eight; 2024 — twenty twenty-four; 2005 — two thousand and five. “I was born in nineteen ninety-eight.”
Yomg‘ir bo‘lmaganida, o‘yin vaqtida tugagan bo‘lardi.
Yomon emas. Yana bir urinib ko‘ramizmi?
Yomon o‘tgan sayohat yoki kunni yozing va 4 ta xulosa chiqaring: nima qilish kerak edi, nima qilmaslik kerak edi.
Yoqilgan qoidani o‘zgartirib bo‘lmaydi — avval o‘chiring
Yoqilg‘i narxi oshgani sababli ko‘proq odam ishga velosipedda qatnamoqda.
Yoqishdan oldin creator chegarasi va umumiy byudjetni kiriting
Yoqishdan oldin foiz yoki summani kiriting
Yordam berishni qanchalik xohlamay, shunchaki vaqtim yo‘q.

Yordam so‘rash: “Excuse me, can you help me?” “Where is the bus station?” “Do you speak English?” “I’m lost.” (adashdim). Yo‘lni so‘rash: “How do I get to the centre?” “Is this the right bus to the airport?” “Does this bus go to the airport?”
Yordam taklifi: “Your bag looks heavy. I’ll carry it.” Savol shaklida: “Shall I open the window?” Va’da: “I’ll call you tonight, I promise.” “I won’t be late.” (won’t = will not)
Yordam va va’da: I’ll help you
Yordamchi fe’l bo‘lmasa, do / does / did qo‘shiladi: She rarely complains. → Rarely does she complain.
Yordamchi yo‘q edi: did + she + pass.
Yosh 'to be' bilan aytiladi: I am 20 years old (I have emas).
Yosh haqida “He is 45” yoki “He is 45 years old” deymiz (“He has 45” demang — o‘zbekchadan so‘zma-so‘z o‘girmang). Kasbdan oldin a yoki an: a driver, an engineer.
Yosh to be bilan: How old is…?

Yosh “to be” bilan aytiladi: I am 20 (years old). “I have 20 years” — xato, o‘zbekcha yoki ruscha tarjima qilmang. Telefon raqami raqamma-raqam aytiladi, 0 — “oh” yoki “zero”. Narx: How much is it? — It’s five pounds / ten dollars.
Yosh “to be” bilan: I am 25. “I have 25 years” emas.
Yosh: I am + son + years old.
Yoshlar internetda haddan tashqari ko‘p vaqt o‘tkazadi, degan fikr keng tarqalgan.
Yoshlar turmush qurguncha ota-onasi bilan yashashi kerakmi?

Yoshni ham be bilan aytamiz: “I’m 20.” (“I have 20” emas). Savol: “How are you?” — “I’m fine, thanks.” “How do you feel?” — “I feel tired.” Feel + sifat: feel happy, feel better (yaxshiroq his qilmoq).
You ___ be serious! A flat for $10? (bo‘lishi mumkin emas)
You ___ touch that wire! It’s dangerous. (taqiq)
You bilan har doim are ishlatiladi — birlikda ham, ko‘plikda ham.
You have right emas — You’re right
You should ______ your opinion with reasons. (asoslamoq)
You’d better ___ be late for the interview. (inkor)
You’re right — to‘g‘ri aytasiz (You have right emas).
Yoy uzunligi va sektor yuzasini markaziy burchak bo‘yicha topasiz, aylana tenglamasini o‘qiysiz va markaz bilan radiusni aniqlaysiz.
Yozilishi: odatda + ing (read → reading); oxiridagi -e tushadi (dance → dancing); qisqa so‘zda oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi (swim → swimming, run → running).
Yozishdan oldin 2 daqiqa reja tuzing. Reja 10 daqiqani tejaydi.
Yozishdan oldin savolning kalit so‘zlarini tagiga chizing va 2 daqiqa reja tuzing.
Yozishni boshlashdan oldin besh daqiqa reja tuzing.

Yozma ish va IELTS uchun a lot of o‘rniga: a great deal of / a large amount of + sanalmaydigan (a great deal of time, a large amount of money); a large number of / numerous + sanaladigan ko‘plik (a large number of students).
Yo‘l ko‘rsatish va ko‘rsatma berish uchun buyruq gaplarni (Go, Turn, Don’t…) tuzasiz.
Yo‘l ko‘rsatish va shahringizni tasvirlash: “Turn left, the big museum is next to the park.”
Yo‘l ko‘rsatish: go straight on (to‘g‘riga yuring), turn left / right (chapga / o‘ngga buriling), take the second street (ikkinchi ko‘chaga kiring).
Yo‘l va yordam so‘raysiz (Excuse me, can you help me?), tushunmasangiz takrorlashni so‘raysiz va zarur iboralarni (I need a doctor) bilasiz.
Yo‘nalish so‘zlarini (opposite, next to, on the left of, at the far end) eshitib, xaritadagi joyni to‘g‘ri belgilaysiz.
Yo‘q. Ovoz yozib olinmaydi; AI yoqilganda faqat suhbat matni yuboriladi.
Yumshatish: sort of / kind of (ma’lum ma’noda, biroz): “It was kind of strange.” Ro‘yxatni tugatish: and so on, and stuff like that, and that kind of thing, and whatnot (norasmiy).
Yumshoq, dalilga mos xulosa: may have contributed.
Yumshoq, dalilga mos: may have contributed.
Yumshoqroq maslahat: I think you should… / I don’t think you should… (“I think you shouldn’t” dan ko‘ra tabiiyroq).
Yuqoridagi karta va summani kiriting (nusxalash uchun bosing).

Yuza formulalari: to‘g‘ri to‘rtburchak l · w; uchburchak ½ · b · h; parallelogram b · h; trapetsiya ½(b₁ + b₂)h; doira πr². Aylana uzunligi 2πr. Hajm: prizma / quti = asos yuzasi × balandlik (V = lwh); silindr πr²h; konus ⅓πr²h; shar 4/3 πr³; piramida ⅓ · asos yuzasi · h. SAT da bu formulalar test boshida ko‘rsatiladi, lekin yodlab olsangiz vaqt tejaysiz.
Yuzlab, minglab sonlarni aytish, tartib sonlar, pul haqida gapirish, masofa, og‘irlik va haroratni aytish.
Zaiflashtiradi: yo‘lak bo‘lmagan joyda ham o‘sdi — muqobil sabab.
Zamon have/get orqali ko‘rsatiladi: I’m having my phone fixed. / I’ll have the documents translated.

Zamon izchilligi: gapda bir davr bo‘lsa, fe’llar bir xil davrda turadi (“She opened the file and read the report.”). Zamon ko‘rsatkichiga e’tibor: “In 2010, the city ___ (built / builds) a new library.” — o‘tgan zamon. Umumiy haqiqat va ilmiy faktlar — hozirgi zamon (“Water boils at 100°C.”).
Zamon “be” orqali beriladi: is made (Present Simple), was made (Past Simple), has been made (Present Perfect), will be made (Future), is being made (Continuous), can be made (modal).
Zamonni faqat vaqt uchun emas, muloyimlik, taxmin va jonli hikoya uchun ishlatish.
Zavod yopildi. Natijada yuzlab odam ishsiz qoldi.
Zero conditional — har doim to‘g‘ri bo‘ladigan natija (fakt, qoida, odat): If you heat ice, it melts. If I drink coffee at night, I can’t sleep. Ikkala qismda ham present simple.
Zid fikr va xulosa so‘zlari: however / therefore.
[PASSAGE] — matn abzatslari; listening uchun [SCRIPT] — “A: gap” qatorlari.
[QUESTIONS] — “## Ko‘rsatma” guruh boshlaydi. Savollar: T (True/False/Not Given), M (test, to‘g‘ri variant oldida *), H (moslashtirish), F (bo‘sh joy ______, javoblar ; bilan).
___ finds the wallet should take it to the police. (kim bo‘lsa ham)
___ he will accept the offer is still unclear. (…mi yo‘qmi)
___ much you earn, save some money. (qanchalik)
___ some people enjoy crowds, others find them stressful. (taqqoslash)
___ the price was high, demand stayed strong. (in spite of the fact that → bir so‘z)
___ the roads were flooded, schools were closed. (sabab, to‘liq gap)
______, most people pay by phone. (hozirgi kunda)
a / an — “qandaydir bitta”, tinglovchi hali bilmaydi: “There is a café near my house.”
a double-edged sword — foydasi ham, zarari ham bor.
a double-edged sword — neytral, rasmiy matnda ham uchraydi.
a fall / rise IN something — of emas.
a few — “bir nechta”, faqat sanaladigan ko‘plik bilan: a few eggs, a few friends. a little — “ozgina”, faqat sanalmaydigan bilan: a little sugar, a little time.
a great deal of / a large amount of + sanalmaydigan
a great deal of, a large number of, the vast majority, a significant proportion kabi rasmiy miqdor iboralarini to‘g‘ri ot turi va fe’l bilan ishlatasiz.
a large number of / numerous + ko‘plik
a loaf of bread — bitta butun non.
a lot of + har qanday ot
a lot of — ko‘p (har qanday ot).
a lot of — “ko‘p”, ikkala turdagi ot bilan ham ishlaydi: a lot of apples, a lot of water.
a lot of, a few, a little ni sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlar bilan to‘g‘ri tanlaysiz.
a no-brainer — o‘ylab o‘tirishga hojat yo‘q, aniq to‘g‘ri tanlov.
a vicious circle — essega mos obrazli ibora.

a yoki an — keyingi so‘zning birinchi TOVUSHIga qarab: undosh bo‘lsa a (a pen, a bag, a red umbrella), unli bo‘lsa an (an apple, an umbrella, an orange bag). Ko‘rdingizmi: umbrella oldiga rang qo‘shilsa, a ga aylanadi!
according to me emas — in my opinion
accuse of, blame for, congratulate on, prevent from, insist on kabi fe’l + predlog birikmalarini xatosiz ishlatasiz.
address an issue — masalani hal qilishga kirishmoq.
afraid from / good in / angry on — xato predlog
agree to you emas — agree with you
agree — fe’l, am kerak emas; agree with + odam.
all, both, either, neither, none bilan guruh yoki ikki narsa haqida aniq gapirasiz.
allow + kishi + to + fe’l — rasmiyroq ruxsat: “The school doesn’t allow students to use phones.” Majhul: be allowed to — “We aren’t allowed to park here.”
although / even though + to‘liq gap (ega + fe’l): Although it was raining, we went out.
although / even though, however, despite / in spite of yordamida qarama-qarshi fikrlarni grammatik to‘g‘ri bog‘laysiz.
although bilan but / however bir gapda kelmaydi.
always + present continuous — odatiy, lekin asabga tegadigan harakat (norozilik ohangi): “My brother is always taking my charger!”
always + present continuous, keep + -ing va will bilan kimningdir odatidan norozilik yoki tavsifni ifodalaysiz.
always, usually, often, sometimes, never so‘zlarini gapda to‘g‘ri joyga qo‘yasiz.
am / is / are + -ing bilan aynan hozir bo‘layotgan harakatlarni aytasiz va Present Simple’dan farqlaysiz.
am / is / are + going to + fe’l
am / is / are going to + fe’l
am / is / are ni to‘g‘ri tanlab, o‘zingiz va boshqalar haqida 5 ta oddiy gap tuzasiz.
am / is → was, are → were. “I am at home” (hozir) → “I was at home yesterday” (kecha).
an — unli TOVUSH bilan boshlanadigan so‘zdan oldin: an engineer, an artist, an hour. a — undosh tovushdan oldin: a doctor, a university (“yu” tovushi).
and / but dan keyin bir xil ega va yordamchi fe’l tushadi: “She opened the door and (she) looked outside.” Javobda so‘zni to‘liq qaytarish xato emas, lekin C1 da mexanik va sun’iy eshitiladi.
and / but dan keyin ega tushadi
and, but, or: qo‘shish, qarama-qarshi qo‘yish, tanlash
aniq bila olmadim (ishonchim komil emas edi)
aniq vaqt bilan Present Perfect ishlatilmaydi
aniqlashtirish: I mean / as I was saying
apostrof: egalik ’s / s’; qisqartma it’s = it is
apple, egg kabi sanaladigan va water, rice kabi sanalmaydigan otlarni farqlab, a/an va ko‘plikni to‘g‘ri ishlatasiz.
arguably, ostensibly, presumably, undeniably, supposedly kabi ravishlar bilan muallif munosabatini bir so‘zda nozik bildirasiz.
artist unli tovush bilan: an artist.
as soon as — “… bilanoq”: As soon as I got home, I called my mum. until — “… gacha”: We waited until the rain stopped.
as soon as, until, by the time, before/after + -ing bilan voqealar orasidagi vaqtni aniq bog‘laysiz.

as — because ning biroz rasmiyroq sinonimi, ko‘pincha gap boshida keladi: As it was late, we took a taxi. Natija: so (shuning uchun): It was late, so we took a taxi. so oldidan odatda vergul qo‘yiladi. Yangi gap boshida That’s why … ham ishlatiladi: The bus was full. That’s why I was late.

as … as bilan: just as / every bit as (xuddi o‘shanday): “The sequel is every bit as good as the original.” Katta farq inkorda: nowhere near as / not nearly as (yaqin ham emas): “The new model is nowhere near as reliable.”
available bilan widely yoki readily keladi.
avvaliga yomon ko‘rinib, aslida foydali chiqqan narsa
ax + b = c ko‘rinishidagi tenglamalarni tez yechasiz, yechim yo‘q va cheksiz ko‘p yechim holatlarini ajratasiz va so‘zli masalani tenglamaga aylantirasiz.
baholovchi ibora (fails to take into account, flawed…)
be bilan barcha egalar uchun were ishlatish tavsiya etiladi: If I were you, I would apologise (maslahat). Og‘zaki nutqda “If I was” ham uchraydi, lekin imtihonda were xavfsizroq.
be bound to / certain to + fe’l
be dan keyin 3-shakl kerak (built, made, written…)
be expected to + fe’lning asl shakli.
be going to + fe’l bilan kelajakdagi rejalaringiz va niyatlaringizni aytasiz.
be going to + fe’l — oldindan o‘ylab qo‘yilgan reja yoki niyat: I’m going to study medicine. Ko‘rinib turgan dalilga asoslangan bashorat: Look at the clouds — it’s going to rain.

be likely to + fe’l — “ehtimoli katta”: Prices are likely to go up. be unlikely to — “ehtimoli kam”: She is unlikely to change her mind. likely bu yerda sifat, shuning uchun to be kerak: “Prices likely to go up” yoki “Prices are likely go up” — xato.
be that as it may — “shunday bo‘lsa ham” (rasmiy, oldingi fikrni tan olib, unga qarshi chiqish): “The plan is expensive. Be that as it may, it is the only option.”
be to + fe’l bilan rasmiy kelishuvlar, yangiliklar va qat’iy ko‘rsatmalarni ifodalaysiz.
be to + fe’l — rasmiy, rejalashtirilgan voqea (ko‘pincha yangiliklarda): “The President is to visit Samarkand next week.” Sarlavhalarda be tushib qoladi: “President to visit Samarkand”.
be used to (ko‘nikkan) va get used to (ko‘nikmoq) ni used to (ilgari …ardim) bilan adashtirmaysiz.
be used to + -ing / ot — “ko‘nikkanman, men uchun odatiy”: “I’m used to getting up early.” get used to + -ing — “ko‘nikmoq” (jarayon): “I’m getting used to the cold weather.”
because / since (due to the fact that o‘rniga)
because of / due to / owing to (+ ot), because / since (+ gap), therefore / consequently / as a result (yangi gap) ni grammatik to‘g‘ri ishlatasiz.
because of dan keyin to‘liq gap emas — ot
because va so birga emas; because of dan keyin to‘liq gap kelmaydi.
because va so: sabab va natija
because, because of, as, so va that’s why ni farqlab, sabab va natijani to‘g‘ri bog‘laysiz.
before / after dan keyin -ing ishlatish mumkin (ega bir xil bo‘lsa): After finishing work, she went to the gym. Before leaving, check the windows.
belgilangan. Avval o‘zingiz yozib ko‘ring, keyin solishtiring: so‘zlarni ko‘chirmang, o‘z fikringiz bilan ishlating.
beneficial, children, numerous, issues kabi rasmiy so‘zlarni ishlating.
beyond it = undan keyin; on the left.
bir o‘q bilan ikki quyonni urmoq
bound to, likely / unlikely to, may well, there’s every chance bilan ehtimollikni aniq darajada ifodalaysiz.
bread sanalmaydi — a piece of bread.
bread sanalmaydi: some bread (yoki a loaf of bread).
bridge the gap between — tafovutni qisqartirmoq.
butun son: maksimum uchun pastga yaxlitlash
by the time + Present Simple (will emas)
by the time — “… paytga kelib” (ko‘pincha past perfect bilan): By the time we arrived, the shop had closed.
by the time … will have + V3.
call dan keyin to qo‘yilmaydi: call you.
call me back — qayta qo‘ng‘iroq qilmoq.
call somebody back — qayta qo‘ng‘iroq qilmoq.
call to me emas — call me
can + fe’lning oddiy shakli — barcha egalar uchun bir xil: I can swim. She can drive. “She cans” yoki “can to swim” — xato.
can / can’t bilan nimani qila olishingizni aytasiz, so‘raysiz va oddiy iltimos qilasiz.
can dan keyin to ham, -s ham kelmaydi

can ning o‘tgan zamon shakli — could: I can swim now. → I could swim when I was six. could dan keyin ham fe’l oddiy shaklda keladi va hamma egalar uchun bir xil: she could, they could. “She coulds”, “could to swim”, “could swam” — xato.
carry out — ilmiy matnda keng ishlatiladi.
consistent with / concur with bo‘lishi kerak
could dan keyin oddiy fe’l (to yoki o‘tgan zamon shakli emas)
couldn’t afford the rent = too high.
counters / concedes → qarshi fikr / tan olish
dan yuqori ko‘rsatilmaydi: yuqori ball uchun qiyinroq testlarni yeching.

despite / in spite of + ot yoki -ing: Despite the rain, we went out. In spite of feeling tired, she finished the report. Xato: “Despite it was raining” — despite dan keyin gap kelmaydi (despite the fact that … mumkin).
despite dan keyin to‘liq gap emas, ot yoki -ing keladi
did / didn’t dan keyin “use to” (d siz)
did / didn’t yordamida o‘tgan zamonda savol berasiz va inkor gap tuzasiz.
did dan keyin fe’l har doim ODDIY shaklda bo‘ladi: “Did you went?” — xato, “Did you go?” — to‘g‘ri. O‘tgan zamon belgisi did da bor.
did dan keyin fe’l oddiy shaklda bo‘lishi kerak
did dan keyin oddiy shakl: pass.
didn’t have to / didn’t need to — kerak emas edi, va odatda QILINMAGAN: “I didn’t need to take a taxi — my friend drove me.”
do / does bilan savol va inkor
do / does yordamida Present Simple’da savol berasiz va don’t / doesn’t bilan inkor qilasiz.
do a mistake / make homework / make a photo — xato birikma
do so — rasmiy yozuvda fe’l birikmasini almashtiradi: “Students who wish to leave early may do so.” do it / do that — og‘zaki va aniq harakat.
doctor undosh tovush bilan boshlanadi: a doctor.
does dan keyin fe’l -s siz: speak.
does dan keyin oddiy fe’l: cost.
does dan keyin oddiy fe’l: mean.
doesn’t dan keyin oddiy fe’l: want.
don’t / doesn’t have to = shart emas
due to / because of dan keyin to‘liq gap emas, ot keladi
due to / owing to / because of + ot
each / every + birlik (every student has), the whole + birlik (the whole country), all (of) the + ko‘plik (all the students). “The number of …” — birlik: “The number of cars IS increasing.”
echo those of — … ning natijalarini takrorlaydi.
ega + could + fe’l + when bilan vaqt.
ega kerak: It is cold (Is cold emas)
engineer unli tovush bilan: an engineer.
enjoy, finish, avoid (+ -ing) va want, decide, hope (+ to) kabi fe’llardan keyin to‘g‘ri shaklni tanlaysiz.
essega mos: pave the way for
ever + vaqtsiz tajriba: Have you ever…
every bit as / just as + sifat + as
every cloud (has a silver lining) — har yomonlikning yaxshi tomoni bor.
every- so‘zlaridan keyin fe’l birlikda: is.
f(x) yozuvidan foydalanasiz (qiymat topish, kompozitsiya), grafik siljish va akslantirishlarni aniqlaysiz va ildizli tenglamalarda chet (extraneous) yechimni tekshirasiz.
fails to take into account / overlooks + ot
faqat o‘sha gap va uning atrofi
fe’l + predlog: insist on, rely on, apologise for, object to, succeed in, consist of, depend on, specialise in.
fikr iborasi (I think, In my opinion…)
fikr ma’nosida I think (I am thinking emas)
fikrni asoslovchi bog‘lovchi (because, however, for example…)
for your birthday — tug‘ilgan kuningiz uchun.
get the ball rolling — ishni boshlab yubormoq.
good → better, bad → worse (more good emas).
g‘ayritabiiy kollokatsiya (make a threat, do research, do a mistake…)
had + V3 bilan o‘tgan zamondagi voqeadan ham OLDIN bo‘lgan voqeani ko‘rsatasiz.

had better (qisqasi ’d better) — kuchliroq: maslahat + ogohlantirish, ya’ni “aks holda yomon bo‘ladi”: You’d better take an umbrella (or you’ll get wet). Shakli o‘tmishga o‘xshasa ham, ma’nosi hozir yoki kelajak. Undan keyin to SIZ oddiy fe’l keladi: You’d better go. Inkor: You’d better not be late.
had better + oddiy fe’l; inkori — had better not.
had better to / ought + fe’l (to siz) — xato
had to — o‘tmishda majbur bo‘lgan: “I had to work late yesterday.” (must ning o‘tmish shakli yo‘q, had to ishlatiladi.)
had to, didn’t have to / didn’t need to va needn’t have + V3 orasidagi nozik farqni tushunib ishlatasiz.
hair -s olmaydi va have got bilan keladi.

hair — sanalmaydi: ko‘plik -s ham, a ham olmaydi (brown hairs emas, brown hair). eyes esa ko‘plik: blue eyes. Kimdir ko‘zoynak taqsa: He wears glasses. Tashqi ko‘rinishni so‘rash: What does she look like?
happen / die / arrive / exist o‘timsiz — passivi yo‘q
have + narsa + V3: have it cut.
have / has + 3-shakl bilan hayotiy tajriba haqida so‘raysiz va gapirasiz (ever, never, before).
have / has been + -ing bilan o‘tmishda boshlanib hozirgacha davom etayotgan harakatni aytasiz.
have dan keyin 3-shakl: ride – rode – ridden.
have paved the way for — yo‘l ochgan.
have to — tashqi qoida yoki majburiyat: I have to wear a uniform at work. must — ko‘pincha gapiruvchining o‘z fikri yoki rasmiy qoida: I must call my mother. Ma’nosi yaqin.
have → has. Bu xatoni ko‘pchilik qiladi: “He have a car” — xato, “He has a car” — to‘g‘ri.
have, do, go, get, make, take fe’llarini to‘g‘ri iboralar bilan ishlatasiz va kun tartibingizni aytasiz.
have, do, go, get, make, take: eng ko‘p ishlatiladigan fe’llar
he / she / it bilan has: She has worked abroad. Qisqartmalar: I’ve, she’s, they’ve.
he / she yoki oila a’zosi aytilgan
he, she, it bilan Present Simple’da fe’lga -s / -es / -ies ni to‘g‘ri qo‘shasiz.
he/she/it (yoki bitta shaxs) bilan Present Simple da fe'lga -s/-es qo'shiladi.
hear from you — sendan xabar olmoq.
holat aytilgan (I’m on my way / I’m late / I’m at…)
home oldidan to qo‘yilmaydi: go home.
hour — “h” o‘qilmaydi, unli tovush bilan boshlanadi: an hour.
however + sifat / ravish — “qanchalik … bo‘lmasin”: “However hard I try, I can’t remember his name.” Bu bog‘lovchi however (lekin) dan farq qiladi — undan keyin sifat keladi va vergul yo‘q.
however — ikki alohida gapni bog‘laydi, odatda yangi gap boshida va vergul bilan: It was raining. However, we went out.
hundred aniq son bilan -s olmaydi: three hundred.
if + Present Simple inkor: doesn’t study.
if ni tushirib, Should / Were / Had bilan rasmiy shart gaplar tuzasiz.
if qismida would yo‘q; Past Simple.
ikki tig‘li qilich (foydasi ham, zarari ham bor)
imply vs infer — eng ko‘p adashtiriladi: imply — so‘zlovchi bilvosita bildiradi (“The report implies that…”); infer — tinglovchi xulosa chiqaradi (“From the data, we can infer that…”).
in + oy, yil, fasl, kun qismi

in which case = “bunday holda”: “The flight may be cancelled, in which case we’ll take the train.” at which point / by which time — vaqtni bog‘laydi: “The rain stopped at 5, by which time the match had been cancelled.”
in — biror narsaning ichida yoki shahar/mamlakatda: in the bag, in Tashkent. on — sirtda yoki ko‘chada: on the table, on Navoi Street. at — aniq nuqtada: at the bus stop, at home, at school.
in — uzunroq davr: in May, in 2025, in summer, in the morning / afternoon / evening. Diqqat: in the morning, lekin at night.
in, on, at, next to, between, opposite, behind, in front of bilan joylashuvni aniq aytasiz.

into — ichiga (go into the cave), out of — ichidan tashqariga (come out of the tunnel), across — bir tomondan ikkinchi tomonga (walk across the bridge), through — ichidan o‘tib (drive through the forest), along — bo‘ylab (walk along the river), up / down — yuqoriga / pastga (climb up the hill), past — yonidan o‘tib (go past the school).
inversiya: inkor so‘z + yordamchi fe’l + ega
inversiyada yordamchi fe’l egadan oldin keladi
is → was, tartib: what my name was.
it — try va on orasida: try it on.
joy predlogi ishlatilgan (on, under, next to…)
just over / just under / nearly + ulush
just — hozirgina: I have just eaten. already — allaqachon (kutilganidan oldin): She has already left. Ikkalasi have va V3 orasida turadi.
k = 9 da tenglama cheksiz yechimli; boshqa k da yechim yo‘q.
kamida 2 ta fasl (in summer, in winter…)
kamida 2 ta some- / any- / no- / every- so‘zi
kasr / ulush so‘zi (a quarter, half, one in ten)
keep (on) + -ing — “to‘xtamay, qayta-qayta”: “The printer keeps breaking down.” “He keeps calling me.”
know / like / want / need odatda -ing olmaydi
kollokatsiya (make a decision, take a risk…)
kunlik seriya uzildi. 48 soat ichida kunlik maqsadni 2 barobar bajarsangiz, tiklanadi (30 kunda bir marta).
like / love / hate / don’t like dan keyin fe’lni -ing shaklida ishlatib, sevimli mashg‘ulotlaringizni aytasiz.
mainly feed on small insects; spiders — qo‘shimcha.
make + kishi + fe’l (to SIZ) — majburlash: “My parents made me do my homework.” let + kishi + fe’l (to siz) — ruxsat berish: “They let me stay up late.”
make + ot (make progress, make an effort)
make / let + kishi + fe’l (to siz), allow + kishi + to va be allowed to tuzilmalarini adashtirmaysiz.
make a mistake — “xato qilmoq”, lekin do emas.
make, do, take va have bilan keladigan asosiy birikmalarni (make progress, do damage, take responsibility, have an impact) gapda to‘g‘ri tanlaysiz.
mavzulari. Qolganlari Grammar obunasi bilan ochiladi.
may / might / could + fe’l bilan hozirgi va kelajakdagi ehtimollikni ifodalaysiz.
may / might / tend to / it could be argued / arguably kabi vositalar bilan fikrni haddan tashqari qat’iy qilmasdan ifodalaysiz.

may / might bilan “balki” deyishni bilasiz. Muhokamada esa ishonch darajasini aniqroq ko‘rsatish foydali: ~100% — will definitely / definitely won’t; ~80% — will probably / probably won’t; ~50% — might; kam ehtimol — be unlikely to. Masalan: It will probably rain tomorrow. (Ertaga katta ehtimol bilan yomg‘ir yog‘adi.)
may well / be likely to + fe’l
mean = yig‘indi / soni; sum = mean × n
mind you, anyway, as I was saying, by the way, at the end of the day kabi og‘zaki belgilar bilan suhbatni tabiiy boshqarasiz.
mis- / over- / under- / re- li so‘z
money sanalmaydi: a lot of money.
more than once — bir necha marta.
muammo birikmasi (pose a threat, put pressure on)
much as, sifat + as / though + ega + fe’l, however much, be that as it may kabi nafis yon berish tuzilmalarini ishlatasiz.
my, your, her — otdan oldin keladi: my bag. mine, yours, hers — o‘zi yolg‘iz, otsiz: “This bag is mine.” (Bu sumka meniki.)
needn’t have + V3 — kerak emas edi, LEKIN QILINGAN (behuda): “I needn’t have cooked so much — only three guests came.” Bu B2 dagi muhim farq.
never fe’ldan oldin keladi, “are” kerak emas.
never o‘zi inkor ma’noga ega, shuning uchun “I don’t never…” deyilmaydi: “I never eat meat.”
next to / opposite / between / behind / in front of dan biri
next to — yonida, between — orasida (ikki narsa), opposite — ro‘parasida, behind — orqasida, in front of — oldida.
nomi bilan qatnashyapsiz. Hisobdan chiqish — Profil sahifasida.
norasmiy → rasmiy: get rid of → eliminate, come up with → devise
not enough — “yetarli emas”: There isn’t enough time. We don’t have enough chairs. enough otdan OLDIN keladi.
nothing else has a pool of that size — katta hovuz.
noto‘g‘ri ko‘plik: tooth → teeth, foot → feet
noxush, lekin muqarrar ishga jur’at qilmoq
of bilan: both of them, all of us, none of my friends, neither of them. neither / either + birlik ot: neither book (neither books emas).
office — unli tovush: an office worker.
og‘zaki: a piece of cake → straightforward
og‘zaki: cost an arm and a leg → be extremely expensive
on the same page — bir xil fikrda (bu yerda inkor: kelisha olmagan).
on — kun va sana: on Monday, on 8 March, on my birthday.
once a week — haftada bir marta.

one / ones — sanaladigan otni almashtiradi: “I don’t like this jacket. Can I see the blue one?” “The old houses are prettier than the new ones.” Sanalmaydigan ot bilan ishlamaydi: “I prefer white wine to red (one)” — one qo‘yilmaydi.
orange — unli tovush: an orange bag.
ostensibly / supposedly — “go‘yo, ko‘rinishdan” (lekin shubha bor): “The trip was ostensibly for business.” presumably — “taxminimcha, mantiqan”: “Presumably, he forgot.”
ot kerak: a positive effect (effective emas)
ot oldida ravish emas, sifat keladi
over the last ten years — hozirgacha: present perfect.
o‘xshash: tomonlar k, yuza k², hajm k³
o‘zgartirish: «Limitlar» → «Creator (hamkor) dasturi». Faqat yangi hisob-kitoblarga ta’sir qiladi.
o‘zingiz haqingizda gap (I am / I drink…)
parvarish fe’li ishlatilgan (feed, walk, wash, play)
pave the way for — yo‘l ochmoq.
pay by card — karta bilan to‘lamoq.
pen — undosh tovush bilan boshlanadi: a pen.
people sanaladi — the number / proportion of.
play — oddiy fe’l: Does he play…?
play, go, do: sport va mashg‘ulotlar
prognoz: is expected to / will have + V3
prove, demonstrate, indicate, suggest fe’llarini dalil kuchiga mos tanlab, bog‘liqlik (correlation) va sabab-oqibatni (causation) ajratib yozasiz.
qarshi fikr (It could be argued that…)
qarshi: On the other hand / Having said that
qisqa javob berilgan (Yes, I do. / No, she doesn’t.)
qisqartma yoki og‘zaki so‘z (lots of, really, got…) qolgan
raining cats and dogs — eskirgan, darslik iborasi.
raise (to‘ldiruvchili fe’l) awareness; rise to‘ldiruvchi olmaydi.
ravish → sifat: a dramatic increase in.
really ikkala turi bilan ham ishlaydi: really cold, really freezing. Nutqingiz jonli va tabiiy chiqishi uchun extreme sifatlardan foydalaning: “The view was absolutely stunning!”
recommend that + ega + asosiy shakl: drink.
refute — dalil bilan inkor qiladi (rad etdi va isbotladi); dismiss — jiddiy qabul qilmay rad etadi; challenge — shubha ostiga qo‘yadi; overlook — e’tibordan chetda qoldiradi.
regret + -ing — qilgan ishidan afsus: “I regret saying that.” regret + to — rasmiy xabar: “We regret to inform you…” go on + -ing — davom etmoq; go on + to — keyingi ishga o‘tmoq.
remember, forget, stop, try, regret, go on fe’llaridan keyin -ing yoki to tanlash ma’noni qanday o‘zgartirishini bilasiz.
rise, fall, fluctuate, remain stable kabi so‘zlarni darajasi bilan (sharply, slightly) va to‘g‘ri predloglar bilan (to, by, from … to) ishlatasiz.
rose up / fell down — up / down ortiqcha
ro‘yxat oxiri: and stuff like that
s bilan tugagan so‘zga -es qo‘shiladi: buses.
said + kishi emas: told me / said to me
said / told o‘rniga suggest, admit, deny, refuse, promise, warn kabi fe’llarni to‘g‘ri tuzilma bilan ishlatasiz.
saqlandi. Endi uning matnini (transkript) quyiga qo‘ying yoki .srt/.vtt fayl yuklang.
say va tell farqi: say something (said that…), tell SOMEONE something (told me that…). “She said me” — xato.

school, hospital, prison, university, church — asl vazifasi uchun borilsa artiklsiz: go to school (o‘qish uchun), be in hospital (davolanish). Bino sifatida — the: “I went to the school to meet the teacher.”
sheep — uzun “i:”. ship va sit — qisqa.
should / shouldn’t bilan sog‘liq va kundalik muammolar bo‘yicha maslahat berasiz va so‘raysiz.
should dan tashqari ought to, had better va Why don’t you…? bilan maslahat berasiz hamda oddiy maslahatni ogohlantirishdan farqlaysiz.
should have + V3 — “… qilish kerak edi” (lekin qilinmadi): “You should have told me earlier!” (Menga oldinroq aytishingiz kerak edi!)
should have / shouldn’t have + V3 bilan o‘tmishdagi xatolarni tanqid qilasiz yoki afsus bildirasiz.
should have been + -ing — o‘sha paytda qilishi kerak bo‘lgan jarayon: “You should have been listening instead of chatting.”

should ni bilasiz: You should see a doctor. ought to ham xuddi shu ma’noda, biroz rasmiyroq: You ought to see a doctor. Diqqat: ought dan keyin to bor (ought to go), should dan keyin esa yo‘q (should go). Inkori — ought not to, lekin og‘zaki nutqda ko‘pincha shouldn’t ishlatiladi.
shouldn’t have + V3 — “… qilmaslik kerak edi” (lekin qilindi): “I shouldn’t have eaten so much.”
sifat + enough + to + fe’l — “yetarlicha …, qila oladi”: “She is old enough to vote.” enough sifatdan KEYIN keladi (A2 da otdan oldin edi: enough money).
sifat + ot + in (a sharp rise in)
sifat / ravish + as / though + ega + fe’l — “qanchalik … bo‘lmasin”: “Hard as it is, we must keep going.” “Strange though it may seem, he enjoys exams.” Tartib muhim: “As hard it is” — xato.
significant — ma’no va birikma mos keladi.
sin, cos, tan ni qarama-qarshi katet / qo‘shni katet / gipotenuza nisbati sifatida topasiz, to‘ldiruvchi burchaklar munosabatini bilasiz va gradusni radianga almashtirasiz.
since bilan Present Simple emas, Present Perfect kerak
since bilan past simple emas, present perfect
so + sifat/ravish + that: The lecture was so boring that I fell asleep.

so / not butun gapni almashtiradi: think, hope, expect, suppose, be afraid, guess bilan. “Will it rain?” — “I think so. / I hope not. / I’m afraid so.” (“I hope it” — xato.) “I don’t think so” — ko‘proq ishlatiladi, “I think not” rasmiyroq.

so that + ega + can / could / will / would — maqsad uchun boshqa ega bo‘lsa yoki modal kerak bo‘lsa: “I’ll explain it again so that everyone can understand.” “for + -ing” ham maqsad emas, narsaning vazifasini bildiradi: a knife for cutting bread.
so, not, one(s), do so bilan oldin aytilgan gap yoki otni almashtirib, matnni ravon qilasiz.
some — ijobiy gaplarda: There are some shops. any — savol va inkorda: Are there any cafés? There aren’t any parks.
some → everyone, worried → terrified: ma’no kuchayib ketdi.
something, anyone, nothing, everywhere kabi so‘zlarni darak, inkor va so‘roq gaplarda to‘g‘ri tanlaysiz.
